paper.title: DSAQuant: Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training for Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models (VDMs) have achieved impressive progress in text-to-video generation, but their high memory and computational costs hinder practical deployment. Quantization-aware training (QAT) is an effective solution for compressing and accelerating advanced generative models without runtime overhead at inference. However, existing QAT methods suffer from a distinctive challenge in VDMs: while they often preserve prompt semantics, global layout, and coarse motion, the quantized model s

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型量化后常能保留 prompt 语义、全局布局和粗运动，却显著损失纹理、锐度和局部细节；论文试图解释并修复这一失真模式。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成模型的 quantization-aware training 方法，属于生成模型部署效率而非 LLM 预训练。它的可迁移价值在于把量化误差和 diffusion denoising 阶段功能对应起来，这对未来统一 AR+diffusion 多模态模型的压缩可能有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DSAQuant，即 Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training。核心判断是常规 QAT 对所有 timestep 使用近似相同的量化处理，忽略了 denoising 的阶段分工：早期步骤主要确定全局结构和运动，中后期步骤更负责局部外观和高频细节。因此方法按 denoising stage 调整 QAT 目标或训练策略，使量化模型在细节敏感阶段得到更合适的约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体视频扩散模型、bit-width、训练数据、baseline 和量化指标提升。可确认的实验关注点是 text-to-video generation 中量化模型的视觉细节、纹理保真度、清晰度、语义保持和运动一致性。
summary.authors_note: Yujun Shen 在生成模型、GAN/扩散模型编辑和视觉生成方向有代表性工作；Haotong Qin 在模型量化方向有相关研究积累。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode of quantized video diffusion models: prompt semantics, global layout, and coarse motion may survive quantization, while texture, sharpness, and local visual details degrade severely.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a quantization-aware training method for video generation models, so it is not directly about LLM pretraining. Its transferable value is the connection between quantization error and the functional stages of diffusion denoising, which may matter for future unified AR-plus-diffusion multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: DSAQuant stands for Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training. The key idea is that conventional QAT treats timesteps too uniformly, while video diffusion denoising is stage-structured: early steps determine global structure and motion, whereas middle and late steps refine local appearance and high-frequency details. The method aligns the QAT process with these stages so that detail-sensitive denoising phases receive more appropriate constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the specific video diffusion backbone, bit width, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to focus on text-to-video generation quality under quantization, including visual detail, texture fidelity, sharpness, semantic preservation, and motion consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Yujun Shen is known for work on generative models and visual generation/editing; Haotong Qin has relevant work in model quantization.

recommendation.zh: 只看 denoising-stage 归因即可；若做统一多模态 diffusion 压缩，这个量化误差分解值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read only the denoising-stage attribution; if compressing unified multimodal diffusion models, this error decomposition is worth reproducing.

paper.title: HPSD: Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation for Text-Image-to-Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Text-Image-to-Video (TI2V) models are an emerging unified architecture, where a single model simultaneously supports text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) generation. Given a high-quality first frame or a detailed textual prompt, TI2V models unlock substantially better visual quality than their T2V mode, raising a natural question: can the capability elicited by such privileged conditions be internalized into the model's own base generation ability? A common approach toward this goal is m

summary.core_problem: 让 text-image-to-video 模型在有首帧或详细文本条件下表现出的强生成能力，内化到模型自身的基础 text-to-video 生成能力中。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成模型的后训练/自蒸馏方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但其中关于 off-policy 蒸馏、on-policy 状态分布、teacher 条件错配的讨论，对理解生成模型训练信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation。论文指出直接 SFT 属于 off-policy，只学习固定离线 teacher 端点，不能纠正 student 自己访问到的状态；已有 on-policy 蒸馏又有 condition-state mismatch，即监督被首帧条件牵引而不是对齐 student 当前内容。HPSD 试图混合不同策略来源，使蒸馏信号更贴近 student 的生成轨迹，同时保留 privileged condition 的高质量监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 数字或提升幅度；任务范围是 TI2V 模型中的 T2V 与 I2V/TI2V 生成能力迁移，评估应围绕视频质量、条件一致性和基础 T2V 能力提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 Shanghai Jiao Tong University、Nanyang Technological University S-Lab、University of Science and Technology of China、Fudan University、Shanghai Innovation Institute、Shanghai AI Laboratory。Jiaqi Wang 是上海人工智能实验室/OpenMMLab 相关视觉研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to internalize the stronger generation capability elicited by privileged text-image or first-frame conditions into a TI2V model’s base text-to-video generation mode.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/self-distillation method for multimodal generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its treatment of off-policy distillation, on-policy state distributions, and supervision mismatch is relevant to training-signal quality in generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation argues that simple SFT is off-policy because it only learns from fixed offline teacher endpoints, while prior on-policy distillation suffers from condition-state mismatch where the supervision is pulled toward the given first frame rather than the student’s actual content. HPSD mixes policy sources to align distillation with student-visited trajectories while retaining high-quality privileged-condition supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, training data, baseline numbers, or gain magnitudes. The evaluation is framed around transferring I2V/TI2V capability into the base T2V mode, likely using video quality and condition-alignment metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include Shanghai Jiao Tong University, S-Lab at Nanyang Technological University, University of Science and Technology of China, Fudan University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and Shanghai AI Laboratory. Jiaqi Wang is a known vision researcher associated with Shanghai AI Laboratory/OpenMMLab.

recommendation.zh: 看蒸馏状态分布那部分即可；视频方法本身偏远，但 off-policy/on-policy mismatch 对 RLVR 数据有类比价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the state-distribution discussion; the video method is peripheral, but the off-policy/on-policy mismatch maps well to RLVR data design.

paper.title: LoSA: Near-Lossless Sparse Attention for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers are costly to sample: every denoising step applies self-attention over a long 3D token sequence, a quadratic cost that dominates as resolution and duration grow. Sparse attention reduces this cost without retraining, but existing methods pursue aggressive sparsity, where further speedup costs disproportionately more attention fidelity. We target the opposite end of this trade-off: fix near-lossless fidelity by construction, and remove as much computation as this cons

summary.core_problem: 在不训练、不明显损伤视频质量的前提下，降低视频 diffusion transformer 采样阶段长 3D token 自注意力的二次计算开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成推理加速中的注意力稀疏化方法。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对长序列注意力稀疏性、跨 denoising step 的注意力模式稳定性有一定旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: LoSA 不固定稀疏率，而固定 99% retained attention mass。方法先在一个早期 dense denoising step 精确测量 block-level attention mass，再为每个 head 和 query block 保留达到质量阈值所需的最小 key/value block 集合，并在后续步骤复用该高质量支持集。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告两个关键观察：约 40% 的 block interaction 可被移除，同时保留 99% attention mass；高质量 attention support 在 denoising steps 间保持稳定。具体模型、数据集、速度提升和画质指标需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the quadratic self-attention cost of video diffusion transformers during sampling without retraining and without visible quality loss.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time sparse-attention method for video generation. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the measured stability of attention support across denoising steps is a useful signal for long-sequence attention efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoSA fixes a retained-attention-mass threshold rather than a target sparsity ratio. It measures exact block-level attention mass at an early dense denoising step, keeps the smallest key/value block set that reaches 99% mass for each head and query block, and reuses this support in later steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that around 40% of block interactions can be removed while retaining 99% of attention mass, and that high-mass support is stable across denoising steps. Model scale, datasets, speedups, and quality metrics require checking the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention support 稳定性的实验；方法偏视频采样工程，不会直接改预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read only the attention-support stability evidence; the method is mostly video-sampling engineering, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: SPADE: An Input-Adaptive Sparse Attention Engine for Fast Video Diffusion Models Inference
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality but pay quadratic self-attention cost, making inference prohibitive at video-token scales. The challenge is input-adaptive sparsity: selecting critical Q/K/V tokens with negligible overhead and executing them for end-to-end gains. We present SPADE, a training-free sparse-attention engine of three parts: (i) vDiT-SSR, a specification defining 3D blocking candidates and formalizing dynamic masks via Summarizer/Estimator expressions; (ii) r

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 diffusion transformer 在高视频 token 数下自注意力二次复杂度导致推理过慢的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与稀疏注意力工程。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对长序列、多模态生成模型的 attention sparsity 和 kernel 落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPADE，一个免训练的输入自适应稀疏注意力引擎。方法包括 vDiT-SSR 稀疏规则描述、基于 SICS 和 head-wise policy 的运行时方案生成，以及低开销索引搜索、flash block-sparse attention、kernel grouping 组成的执行器。
summary.experiments: 在 Hunyuan-Video 与 Wan 2.1/2.2 上评估文本到视频和图像到视频生成。报告 attention 加速 2.26x-3.40x，端到端推理加速 1.49x-1.80x，同时声称保持生成质量；摘要未给出具体质量指标或显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quadratic self-attention bottleneck in video diffusion transformers at large video-token scales.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-system and sparse-attention contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to long-sequence multimodal generation and practical sparse attention execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPADE is a training-free input-adaptive sparse attention engine. It defines vDiT-SSR for 3D blocking and dynamic mask expressions, generates runtime schemes with SICS and head-wise policies, and executes them through low-overhead index search, flash block-sparse attention, and kernel grouping.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Hunyuan-Video and Wan 2.1/2.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation. The method accelerates attention by 2.26x-3.40x and end-to-end inference by 1.49x-1.80x while claiming preserved quality; the abstract does not expose detailed quality metrics.

recommendation.zh: 知道 vDiT 动态稀疏能拿到端到端收益即可；不做视频生成 serving 的话，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing that adaptive sparsity can yield real end-to-end vDiT speedups; skip the details unless you work on video-generation serving.

paper.title: Token Radius Attention for Efficient Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (VDiTs) enable high-fidelity generation but incur quadratic cost from dense 3D self-attention. Existing head- and block-level sparse methods share computation budgets across queries, overlooking token-specific attention demand. We observe that retained density varies across queries yet correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, while dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods with token-dependent radii. Based on these findings, we propose Token Radi

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer的3D稠密自注意力随token数平方增长，现有稀疏方法在head/block层统一分配计算预算，忽略不同token的注意力需求差异。
summary.importance: 提出训练免费的token级动态稀疏注意力框架，在主流视频生成模型上实现1.5-2x加速且质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach: 观察到query的注意力保留密度与注意力熵呈对数线性相关，核心交互集中在query中心邻域；将每个query的熵映射为独立token预算，转换为带时序衰减的注意力半径，无需显式key排序；通过融合熵提取、warm-up复用、块稀疏掩码构建降低额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo共7个文生视频/图生视频配置上测试，仅保留9-19%注意力交互，实现1.56x-2.05x加速，生成质量与原模型相当。

summary_en.core_problem: 3D dense self-attention in video Diffusion Transformers incurs quadratic cost, while existing sparse methods share computation budgets at head/block granularity, ignoring token-specific attention demand.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free token-level dynamic sparse attention framework that delivers 1.5-2x speedup on mainstream video generation models with negligible quality loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that retained attention density per query correlates log-linearly with attention entropy, and dominant interactions form query-centered neighborhoods; maps per-query entropy to independent token budgets converted to temporally decayed attention radii without explicit key ranking; reduces overhead via fused entropy extraction, warm-up reuse, and block-sparse mask construction.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 7 T2V/I2V configurations of Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo, retains only 9-19% of attention interactions, achieves 1.56x-2.05x speedup with competitive generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 视频生成专用的token级动态稀疏注意力，无排序动态半径的思路可作长上下文LLM稀疏注意力的旁证，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Video-generation-specific token-wise dynamic sparse attention; its ranking-free dynamic radius idea offers minor reference for long-context LLM attention, abstract suffices.

paper.title: Mitigating Compounding Error via Video Representation Regularization
paper.abstract: Video diffusion-based world models enable long autoregressive video generation for robotics, autonomous driving and simulation tasks, yet sliding-window autoregressive inference suffers from severe error accumulation that degrades frame quality over time. Although this phenomenon has been widely observed, the underlying mechanism of compounding error and how to achieve stable long-horizon generation remain largely unresolved. In this paper, we investigate the internal representation dynamics of

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解视频 diffusion world model 在滑窗自回归长 rollout 中逐步漂移、画质和动态一致性恶化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把长时生成的 compounding error 连接到隐藏表示的维度坍缩，并提出 representation regularization 作为稳定长 horizon 生成的训练信号；这对视频世界模型和未来统一多模态 LM 的长程生成稳定性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文分析视频 world model 内部表示动态，用 effective rank 衡量隐藏表示是否保持足够维度；发现生成漂移开始时 effective rank 快速下降。随后提出视频表示正则化，目标是抑制表示坍缩，而不是只靠更多训练数据或更长 rollout 数据覆盖。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖视频 diffusion-based world model 的长自回归生成，并观察到纯训练数据 scaling 不能显著提升抗漂移能力；具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 名称和提升幅度在摘要中未给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why sliding-window autoregressive inference in video diffusion world models accumulates errors and degrades over long rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is linking long-horizon generation drift to dimensional collapse in hidden representations and using representation regularization to stabilize rollout behavior, which is relevant to multimodal generative pretraining and world-model-style sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors inspect internal representation dynamics and use effective rank as a diagnostic for representation collapse. They report that effective rank drops sharply near the onset of generation drift, then introduce a video representation regularizer to maintain healthier hidden-state geometry rather than relying only on data scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on video diffusion-based world models under long autoregressive generation and claims that pure training-data scaling does not improve resistance to error drift; model size, dataset scale, baselines, and exact gains are not specified in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示 rank 分析和 data scaling 失效实验；迁移到 LLM 需谨慎，但长程生成稳定性信号值得复查。
recommendation.en: Read the effective-rank analysis and the failed data-scaling ablation; the LLM transfer is not automatic, but the long-rollout stability signal is worth checking.

paper.title: MXAttention: Data-Free Optimal Scaling and Pre-Normalization Quantization for MXFP4 Attention
paper.abstract: The quadratic cost of attention is a major bottleneck in diffusion-based video generation models. MXFP4 attention provides a promising path toward efficient inference, but direct MXFP4 quantization often degrades generation quality due to two numerical issues: the clipping-underflow trade-off from power-of-two scaling and the row-wise normalization error introduced in the softmax loop. We propose MXAttention, a data-free post-training quantization framework for MXFP4 attention. MXAttention intro

summary.core_problem: 直接将标准MXFP4量化应用于视频扩散Transformer的注意力模块时，会因块内共享2的幂缩放带来的截断-下溢权衡、FlashAttention在线softmax环路的不一致量化破坏行归一化这两种数值失效模式导致生成质量下降，需设计无数据的训练后量化方案解决该问题。
summary.importance: 该方案无需校准数据、量化感知训练或逐层超参数搜索，可直接复用现有MXFP4硬件的原生加速能力，能简化视频生成类多模态基座的低精度推理部署流程；其中基于2的幂微缩放周期性推导闭式最优缩放边界的思路，也可迁移至其他低精度微缩放量化场景。
summary.technical_approach: 包含两个核心组件：一是通用最优缩放（UOS），发现2的幂微缩放引入的周期性结构使最优量化边界与块最大值分布无关，进而推导出闭式边界Q_max=7.25，可直接确定每个MXFP4块的共享缩放因子，全局最小化量化误差；二是预归一化量化（PNQ），在FlashAttention在线softmax环路中先对未归一化的softmax指数块做MXFP4量化，再将同一量化结果同时用于行和累加与输出累加更新，从构造上保证行归一化成立，避免不一致量化路径的额外误差。
summary.experiments: 本次提供的全文内容截断于方法介绍部分，未完整呈现实验结果；方法宣称可实现MXFP4注意力量化下的近无损生成质量，无需校准数据、量化感知训练或逐层超参数搜索。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中对两种数值失效模式的成因拆解、方法部分中UOS闭式缩放边界的推导逻辑与PNQ的流水线设计，可结合图1理解其与FlashAttention的集成方式，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Direct application of standard MXFP4 quantization to attention modules in video diffusion Transformers introduces two numerical failure modes — a clipping-underflow tradeoff from power-of-two shared block scaling, and broken row-wise normalization from inconsistent quantization in the FlashAttention online softmax loop — that cause noticeable generation quality degradation, so this work proposes a data-free post-training quantization solution to close this quality gap.
summary_en.importance: The calibration-free, training-free design directly leverages native MXFP4 hardware acceleration, simplifying low-precision inference deployment for video-generation multimodal foundation models. The closed-form optimal scaling boundary derivation, built on the periodic structure of power-of-two microscaling, also provides a transferable numerical insight for other low-bit microscaling quantization pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two core components are included. First, Universal Optimal Scaling (UOS) identifies a periodic structure induced by power-of-two microscaling that decouples the optimal quantization boundary from the block-maximum distribution, then derives a closed-form boundary Q_max = 7.25 to determine the shared scale of each MXFP4 block with globally minimized quantization error. Second, Pre-Normalization Quantization (PNQ) quantizes unnormalized softmax exponential tiles first in the FlashAttention online softmax loop, then feeds the exact same quantized values to both row-wise sum accumulation and output accumulator updates, which preserves row-wise normalization by construction and eliminates extra error from inconsistent quantization paths.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text is truncated at the method section with no complete experimental results included. The method claims near-lossless generation quality under MXFP4 attention quantization, requiring no calibration data, quantization-aware training, or per-layer hyperparameter search.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the breakdown of two numerical failure modes, focus on the UOS closed-form boundary derivation and PNQ pipeline design in the method section, and refer to Figure 1 for its integration with FlashAttention. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 UOS 推导和 PNQ 的 softmax 误差分析；这是低精度 attention 的可复用数值技巧。
recommendation.en: Read the UOS derivation and PNQ softmax-error analysis; the reusable part is the numerical treatment of low-precision attention.

paper.title: MegaSlide-DiT: Memory-Centric Adaptation and Deformable Local Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: High-resolution video diffusion models built on Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver strong fidelity but quickly exhaust the memory budget of a single workstation. A 100 billion-plus parameter DiT easily requires over a terabyte of persistent state, while naive spatiotemporal self-attention grows quadratically in sequence length. These two walls -- parameter memory and activation memory -- prevent researchers from adapting massive generative models without large GPU clusters. We revisit this pr

summary.core_problem: 解决超大规模视频 DiT 在单机环境下适配时遇到的参数状态内存和时空注意力激活内存瓶颈。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成模型训练/适配的系统方案和局部注意力改造。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对超大多模态生成模型的参数 offload、激活控制和单机实验可行性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MegaSlide-DiT 原型：将持久化权重、master weights 和 optimizer moments 保留在 host memory 中，只按需将瞬时 shard 流式传到 GPU；同时用 3D Deformable Slide Attention 替换二次复杂度的全局时空 self-attention，降低长视频序列的激活压力。
summary.experiments: 摘要称可在一张 H200 GPU 加 1.5 TB host RAM 上适配预训练 105B DiT。未给出训练吞吐、PCIe/NVLink 数据搬运开销、生成质量指标或相对全局注意力 baseline 的具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Trendinsight Lab / UC San Diego。未能从给定信息确认知名作者或团队代表性基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the parameter-state and activation-memory bottlenecks that prevent adapting very large video DiTs on a single workstation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systems recipe for video diffusion adaptation plus a local attention modification. It is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to memory offload, activation control, and feasibility studies for large multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MegaSlide-DiT keeps persistent weights, master weights, and optimizer states in host memory, streaming only transient shards to the GPU on demand. It also replaces quadratic global spatiotemporal self-attention with 3D Deformable Slide Attention to reduce activation pressure for long video sequences.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims adaptation of a pretrained 105B DiT on one H200 GPU with 1.5 TB of host RAM. It does not provide concrete throughput, data-transfer overhead, generation-quality metrics, or numerical comparisons against global-attention baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions are Trendinsight Lab and UC San Diego. No widely known foundation-model author or representative prior work can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 系统假设有意思但吞吐和质量代价未知；只看权重 offload 设计和 3D-DSA 复杂度即可。
recommendation.en: The systems premise is interesting but throughput and quality costs are unclear; read only the weight-offload design and 3D-DSA complexity analysis.

paper.title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
paper.abstract: Multi-agent interactive world models should not only generate consistent observations, but also maintain world states that persist across agents and evolve across views. Existing autoregressive video diffusion pipelines carry forward observation history as conditioning context, which makes shared state difficult to maintain in multi-agent and multi-view settings. We present WorldWeaver (W^2), a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model that augments rollout with cross-agent world state registe

summary.core_problem: 现有自回归视频扩散世界模型将观测历史作为条件上下文传递，无法在多智能体、多视角场景下维护一致的共享世界状态。每个生成步都需要从帧历史重新推断世界信息，既难以保证跨智能体的几何与逻辑一致性，也无法覆盖未被观测到的世界状态变化。
summary.importance: 提出在扩散模型内部显式建模持久化世界状态寄存器的思路，对多智能体世界模型、长时序视频生成的一致性问题有直接参考价值。其用Mixture-of-Transformers分离状态更新与帧生成路径的设计，也为统一建模范式下多任务目标冲突的解决提供了可借鉴的方案。
summary.technical_approach: WorldWeaver（W²）是流式多智能体视频扩散模型，核心设计是跨智能体世界状态寄存器：一组可学习的token，存储共享世界信息和单个智能体状态，在每个生成chunk后动态更新，且在所有智能体和rollout步之间持久共享。训练采用三阶段课程：第一阶段双向训练，用全时序上下文的多智能体同步clip微调教师模型，学习跨智能体场景结构；第二阶段因果训练，将教师转为因果学生模型，加入寄存器监督，继续流匹配目标训练；第三阶段Self-Forcing，用模型自身预测的帧和更新后的寄存器做rollout，暴露寄存器漂移问题。架构上采用Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT），给寄存器token和帧token分配独立权重，同时保持联合注意力，缓解帧生成和状态更新两个目标的竞争。监督信号覆盖单个智能体状态、鸟瞰图全局状态、场景文本语义，还支持半监督训练，少量标注数据锚定寄存器语义，无标注数据提升生成效果。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的全文内容未包含完整实验结果。方法部分已完成架构和训练流程的完整设计，从披露信息看，模型在多智能体世界模型设定下验证了世界状态寄存器对跨智能体一致性和长时序生成稳定性的提升作用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节的世界状态寄存器设计、MoT架构和三阶段训练课程，尤其注意寄存器监督信号的设计逻辑。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing autoregressive video diffusion world models carry observation history as conditioning context, failing to maintain consistent shared world states in multi-agent, multi-view settings. Each generation step requires re-inferring world information from frame history, making it hard to ensure cross-agent geometric and logical consistency, and impossible to account for unobserved world state changes.
summary_en.importance: The work proposes explicitly modeling persistent world state registers inside diffusion models, offering direct reference for consistency problems in multi-agent world models and long-horizon video generation. Its Mixture-of-Transformers design that separates state update and frame generation pathways also provides a reusable solution for resolving multi-task objective conflicts under unified modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldWeaver (W²) is a streaming multi-agent video diffusion model centered on cross-agent world state registers: a set of learnable tokens that store shared world information and individual agent states, are dynamically updated after each generated chunk, and persist across all agents and rollout steps. Training follows a three-stage curriculum: (1) Bidirectional training, which fine-tunes a multi-player teacher on synchronized multi-agent clips with full temporal context to learn cross-agent scene structure; (2) Causal training, which converts the teacher to a causal student, adds register supervision, and continues training with the flow matching objective; (3) Self-Forcing, which rolls out the student on its own predicted frames and updated registers to expose register drift. The architecture uses Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT), assigning separate weights to register tokens and frame tokens while maintaining joint attention, to mitigate competition between the frame generation and state update objectives. Supervision signals cover individual agent status, bird's-eye view global state, and scene text semantics. Semi-supervised training is also supported, where a small labeled subset anchors register semantics while unlabeled videos improve generation quality.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text does not include complete experimental results. The method section presents a complete design of the architecture and training pipeline; disclosed information indicates the model validates improvements in cross-agent consistency and long-horizon generation stability under the multi-agent world model setting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Section 3 for the world state register design, MoT architecture, and three-stage training curriculum, with particular attention to the design logic of register supervision signals. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 register 更新和 MoT 分工；这类显式 latent state 可能比堆长上下文更适合多视角世界模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the register update and MoT split; explicit latent state may be a cleaner route than just extending context for multi-view world models.

paper.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
paper.abstract: Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and ef

summary.core_problem: AlayaWorld 解决的是交互式视频世界模型的长程生成问题：模型既要跟随连续相机控制和可切换文本意图，又要在数十秒到更长 rollout 中保持场景身份、空间结构和局部动态不漂移。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的启发主要在统一世界建模 recipe，而不是单点视觉效果。它把视频 diffusion prior、短块自回归生成、空间记忆、历史纠错训练和少步蒸馏放到同一套训练流程里，展示了视频世界模型从“生成片段”走向“可交互持续环境”时需要哪些训练信号。对 LLM 基座研究员更有用的是两点：第一，长程生成不能只靠扩大上下文，必须引入有结构的有界记忆；第二，训练时要显式暴露模型自己的 rollout 残差，否则推理阶段的小错误会沿时间放大。
summary.technical_approach: 模型基于 15B video diffusion transformer，输出 24-fps、540p 和 720p 视频。生成方式不是一次性生成长视频，而是在 latent 空间按短 chunk 自回归推进，每个 chunk 接收相机轨迹和当前文本 prompt。核心设计是 bounded visual context：包括全局场景 anchor、压缩近期历史、几何对齐的 spatial memory，以及最近帧条件。temporal memory 用来维持短期运动和帧间连续性；spatial memory 存储历史观察，并在回到已访问区域时按目标视角重投影。这样上下文规模随 rollout 长度保持近似常数，避免长视频生成成本线性增长。训练分三阶段：先把通用双向视频 prior 适配到世界建模数据；再转换为带相机控制和时空记忆的自回归生成器；最后用 corrupted histories 和模型自身 rollout 中收集的 replay prediction residuals 做恢复训练，降低长程漂移。推理加速部分采用 discrete autoregressive distillation，结合 distribution-matching distillation、self-forcing++ 和 consistency distillation，把每个 chunk 的采样步数从约 30 步降到 4 步，同时保留控制和记忆模块。
summary.experiments: 数据侧包含 222,147 个 clip，来自 7 个来源，包括内部整理的 MUGEN 和 GameVerse。数据混合覆盖真实世界视频、游戏录像、合成渲染和生成事件视频；每条记录统一为视频、相机内参与位姿，以及和时间线对齐的层级 caption。论文在 iWorld-Bench 上评估生成质量、轨迹跟随和记忆能力，报告 AlayaWorld 在整体指标上优于对比方法。消融重点围绕长程稳定性、空间记忆、历史损坏训练和蒸馏步数。最有信息量的实验结论是：仅依赖近期帧不足以支撑 revisitation；加入几何对齐的 spatial memory 后，回到旧视角时能更好保持场景结构；用模型自身 rollout 残差训练，比只在干净历史上训练更能抑制长程 blur、光照漂移和几何漂移。少步蒸馏把推理步数压到 4 步/块，但论文也承认模型仍主要依赖可见视觉、估计几何和视觉记忆，对物体隐状态、物理因果和长期任务结构的理解有限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 里对 interaction、consistency、stability、efficiency 四个约束的拆分，这决定了方法为什么不能只是一个更大的 video diffusion model。然后看 Training Data，重点关注真实视频、游戏、合成渲染和生成事件的混合方式，以及相机位姿和层级 caption 如何统一成训练记录。方法部分优先看 bounded visual context 和 spatial memory 的设计，尤其是历史观察如何存储、压缩和重投影。实验部分重点看 iWorld-Bench 的 memory ability、trajectory following，以及 corrupted history / replay residual 的消融。蒸馏章节适合快速读，关注 30 步到 4 步的代价和画质控制取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: AlayaWorld targets long-horizon interactive video world modeling: the model must follow continuous camera controls and changing text intents while preserving scene identity, spatial layout, and local dynamics over extended autoregressive rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the full training recipe rather than the visual demo alone. The work combines a video diffusion prior, chunk-level autoregressive generation, structured bounded memory, rollout-error recovery training, and few-step distillation. It makes a clear point: long-horizon generative stability cannot be solved only by increasing context length. The context has to be structured, and training must expose the model to its own imperfect histories so that small rollout errors do not accumulate unchecked.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built on a 15B video diffusion transformer and generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Instead of producing a full long video in one pass, it generates short latent chunks autoregressively. Each chunk is conditioned on camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. The central mechanism is a bounded visual context composed of a global scene anchor, compressed recent history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. Temporal memory maintains short-range dynamics and frame continuity. Spatial memory stores past observations and reprojects them into the current target view when the camera revisits a region. This keeps per-chunk compute approximately constant as rollout length grows. Training has three stages: adapt a general bidirectional video prior to world-modeling data; convert it into an autoregressive generator with camera control and spatiotemporal memory; then train with corrupted histories and replay prediction residuals collected from the model’s own rollouts. For inference, the paper uses discrete autoregressive distillation with distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing sampling from roughly 30 steps to 4 steps per chunk while keeping the control and memory stack active.
summary_en.experiments: The training corpus contains 222,147 clips from seven sources, including internally curated MUGEN and GameVerse data. It mixes real-world videos, gameplay recordings, synthetic renderings, and generated event videos. Each record is normalized into video frames, camera intrinsics and poses when available or recoverable, and timeline-aligned hierarchical captions. Evaluation is performed on iWorld-Bench, covering generation quality, trajectory following, and memory ability. The paper reports stronger overall performance than compared systems. The most informative ablations concern spatial memory, corrupted-history training, replay residuals, and distillation. The reported pattern is consistent: recent-frame conditioning alone is insufficient for revisitation; geometry-aligned memory improves preservation of previously seen regions; training on model-induced imperfect histories reduces long-horizon blur, illumination drift, and geometric drift. The paper also states a clear limitation: the model still represents the world mainly through visible observations, estimated geometry, and visual memory, so object state, physical causality, and long-term task structure remain weak.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Start with the Introduction’s decomposition into interaction, consistency, stability, and efficiency; it explains why a larger video generator is not sufficient. Then read the Training Data section for the mixture of real videos, gameplay, synthetic renderings, generated events, camera poses, and hierarchical captions. In the method, focus on bounded visual context and spatial memory, especially how past observations are stored, compressed, and reprojected. In experiments, prioritize iWorld-Bench memory ability, trajectory following, and the ablations on corrupted histories and replay residuals. The distillation section can be read more quickly, with attention to the trade-off behind reducing sampling from about 30 steps to 4 steps per chunk.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 pretrain，但长时程记忆怎么做得“有界而不崩”讲得很像下一代统一生成模型；先看 bounded context 设计，再看训练课程。
recommendation.en: Not a text-pretraining paper, but the bounded-memory recipe for stable long-horizon generation is directly relevant to unified generative modeling; read the context design first, then the curriculum.

paper.title: FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers process long spatio-temporal sequences, making self-attention the main bottleneck in high-resolution video generation. Training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, but adaptive Top-$p$ routing creates uneven per-head workloads under multi-GPU sequence parallelism. The resulting workload heterogeneity turns sparse attention into a rank-level straggler problem. We present \method{}, a training-free sparse-attention system that improves the distributed execution ef

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer中，训练无关的自适应Top-p稀疏注意力在多GPU序列并行下会出现各头负载不均，导致秩级straggler问题，降低分布式执行效率。
summary.importance: 系统类工作，指出了自适应稀疏注意力在分布式序列并行下的负载失衡痛点，提出的运行时负载均衡方案对长序列模型的分布式效率优化有少量参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FVAttn训练无关稀疏注意力系统：1）前端采用Top-p路由加Top-k安全下限、视频感知块组织做稀疏路由，运行时修正物化掩码；2）运行时负载均衡通过P2P通信迁移少量计算过重的attention head，缩短关键路径；3）Slack感知稀疏增强利用非关键秩的空闲算力填充额外高价值块；4）算子调度重叠掩盖开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体模型参数量、baseline对比或速度提升幅度，仅描述系统设计思路。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中山大学、腾讯微信HPC/微信视觉团队、北京大学，腾讯微信团队负责视频生成相关系统优化工作。

summary_en.core_problem: In video Diffusion Transformers, training-free adaptive Top-p sparse attention causes uneven per-head workloads under multi-GPU sequence parallelism, leading to rank-level stragglers that degrade distributed execution efficiency.
summary_en.importance: A systems work identifying the load imbalance pain point of adaptive sparse attention in distributed sequence parallel settings, with a runtime load balancing solution that provides minor reference value for long-sequence model distributed optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FVAttn, a training-free sparse attention system: 1) a sparse routing frontend with Top-p routing, a Top-k safety floor, and video-aware block organization, with runtime mask materialization repair; 2) runtime load balancing that migrates overloaded attention heads via P2P communication to shorten the critical path; 3) slack-aware sparse augmentation that fills residual idle compute on non-critical ranks with additional high-value attention blocks; 4) overlapped scheduling to hide overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific model scales, baseline comparisons, or speedup numbers; only system design is described.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Sun Yat-sen University, Tencent WeChat HPC/WeChat Vision, and Peking University; the WeChat team works on video generation system optimization.

recommendation.zh: 针对视频DiT的稀疏注意力分布式优化，思路可参考但块设计绑定视频结构，做长序列LLM并行的人扫下负载均衡部分即可。
recommendation.en: A distributed sparse attention optimization for video DiTs; the load balancing idea is transferable but block design is video-specific; only scan the load balancing section if working on long-sequence LLM parallelism.

paper.title: Kaleido: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Video Diffusion Transformers by Exploiting Latent Space Correlations
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality video but introduce extremely high compute cost due to the long diffusion timesteps and self attention computation. As diffusion timesteps are reduced, the computation cost of self attention becomes the dominant bottleneck. Existing acceleration approaches largely inherit sparse attention techniques from large language models, which fail to consider the unique spatiotemporal correlation of video data.   This paper presents Kaleido, an al

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散 Transformer 推理计算量极高，现有从 LLM 继承的稀疏注意力方法未利用视频潜空间特有的时空相关性，加速与质量 tradeoff 不佳。
summary.importance: 算法-硬件协同设计工作，提出利用潜空间通道级时空相关性实现全算子加速，属于视频扩散模型推理效率方向的架构级创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Kaleido 软硬件协同方案：算法侧设计轻量通道复用机制，通过复用部分计算跳过冗余操作；硬件侧设计可重构脉动阵列加速器与轻量数据调度逻辑，匹配复用模式。
summary.experiments: 相比现有稀疏注意力方法，生成质量高出 17 dB 以上；在视频扩散 Transformer 全链路实现加速，具体吞吐与能效数据需看正文硬件评测部分。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交通大学、复旦大学等高校计算机体系结构与系统研究团队，专注 AI 加速器与算法硬件协同设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Video diffusion transformers have extremely high inference compute cost, and existing sparse attention methods inherited from LLMs fail to exploit the unique spatiotemporal correlations in video latent space, leading to poor speed-quality tradeoffs.
summary_en.importance: An algorithm-hardware co-design work that leverages channel-wise spatiotemporal correlations in latent space to accelerate all vDiT operations, representing architectural innovation in video diffusion inference efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents Kaleido, a hardware-software co-design: on the algorithm side, a lightweight channel-wise reuse mechanism skips redundant computation by reusing partial results; on the hardware side, a reconfigurable systolic array accelerator with lightweight data dispatch is designed to match the reuse pattern.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves over 17 dB higher generative quality than prior sparse attention methods; end-to-end speedup on video diffusion transformers is reported, with exact throughput and energy efficiency numbers detailed in the hardware evaluation section.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from computer architecture and systems groups at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Fudan University, and other institutions, focusing on AI accelerators and algorithm-hardware co-design.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散专用硬件加速，与 LLM 预训练无直接关联，仅对做多模态推理加速的研究者有参考价值，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Specialized hardware acceleration for video diffusion, no direct relevance to LLM pretraining; only useful for multimodal inference acceleration researchers, read abstract only.

paper.title: ACID: Adaptive Caching for vIDeo generation
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models produce high-quality generations but remain slow at inference due to their sequential denoising procedure. Caching-based acceleration methods address this by reusing intermediate model outputs: leading dynamic approaches such as TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache accumulate a drift signal and skip expensive model evaluations when accumulated drift stays below a fixed threshold τ. This threshold controls an apparent tradeoff - raising it yields faster generation at the cost o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决视频 diffusion 生成推理中的缓存调度问题。已有 TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache 等动态缓存方法通常用固定阈值判断是否跳过一次昂贵的模型前向，但固定阈值会在关键去噪步上缓存过度，造成质量损失；如果阈值设得保守，又会损失加速收益。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性有限，更接近 diffusion/video generation serving 优化。但对统一多模态生成模型、AR+diffusion 混合建模和视频生成系统有参考价值。核心启发是：扩散采样过程中的每一步并不等价，某些 timestep 的状态变化对最终质量更敏感。固定策略把所有步视为同一风险水平，因此会得到较差的 latency-quality 折中。类似思想也可迁移到多模态生成中的动态计算、early exit、KV/feature cache 和采样预算分配。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析固定阈值缓存的局限。动态缓存方法通常维护一个 accumulated drift metric，用来估计当前模型输出相对上次真实前向的变化。如果累计漂移低于阈值，就复用缓存输出并做轻量修正；如果超过阈值，就执行完整模型前向并重置漂移。ACID 的改动很小：不再让阈值在整个 denoising trajectory 中保持常数，而是根据对应缓存方法的 metric 变化率识别 critical steps，并在这些步骤使用更保守的低阈值，在非关键步骤使用更激进的高阈值。论文具体使用 metric 的二阶变化信号来检测漂移快速变化的位置，因此可以作为 TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache 之上的通用 adaptive threshold wrapper，而不是替换底层缓存指标。
summary.experiments: 论文报告视频 diffusion 生成在单张 A100 上生成约 5 秒视频通常需要 3 到 23 分钟，主要瓶颈来自顺序去噪中的 diffusion backbone。实验覆盖 TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache，以及 HunyuanVideo、Wan 2.1、CogVideoX 等模型。主要结果是，在 TeaCache + HunyuanVideo 设置下，ACID 相比无缓存 baseline 最高达到 2.16× 加速；相比保守固定阈值 baseline 还能获得最高 38% 的额外速度提升，同时质量退化很小：PSNR 下降小于 0.3 dB，SSIM 下降小于 0.01，LPIPS 增加小于 0.01。论文的核心消融点是 critical steps 的存在和位置：在这些步骤上激进缓存会明显伤害质量，而把缓存预算更多放到非关键步骤可以改善同等质量下的延迟。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 fixed-threshold tradeoff 的反例，以及 ACID 方法部分中 accumulated drift、critical steps、二阶变化信号和高低阈值切换的定义。实验部分重点看 Pareto frontier 图、不同缓存方法上的泛化结果，以及质量指标表。若研究重点是 LLM 预训练，可以不细读视频生成细节；若关注 diffusion LM、多模态统一生成或 serving 侧动态计算，则值得看它如何把一个固定超参变成沿采样轨迹变化的调度策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inference-time caching for video diffusion models. Existing dynamic caching methods such as TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache use a fixed threshold on an accumulated drift signal to decide whether to skip an expensive model evaluation. A fixed threshold either caches too aggressively at sensitive denoising steps and hurts quality, or stays conservative and leaves speedup on the table.
summary_en.importance: The work is only indirectly related to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant for diffusion-based multimodal generation and serving. The useful lesson is that denoising steps are not uniformly important. Some timesteps are critical because the model’s intermediate signal changes rapidly, and aggressive reuse at those points has a disproportionate quality cost. This view may transfer to dynamic compute allocation in diffusion LMs, unified AR-diffusion systems, video generation pipelines, and feature-cache scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACID keeps the structure of existing dynamic caching methods but changes the threshold schedule. Standard methods maintain an accumulated drift metric that estimates how much the model output has changed since the last full evaluation. If the drift stays below a user-defined threshold, they reuse cached outputs with lightweight correction; if it exceeds the threshold, they run the full model and reset the drift. ACID replaces the constant threshold with an adaptive one. It monitors the rate of change of the underlying metric and uses a second-derivative-style signal to detect critical steps. It then switches to a lower, more conservative threshold near those steps and a higher, more aggressive threshold elsewhere. Because it operates on top of each method’s own metric, it can wrap TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache rather than requiring a new caching algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The paper notes that generating roughly five-second videos can take about 3 to 23 minutes on a single A100, with most latency coming from the sequential denoising backbone. Experiments cover multiple caching methods, including TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache, and multiple video diffusion models, including HunyuanVideo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX. In the TeaCache and HunyuanVideo setting, ACID reaches up to 2.16× speedup over the no-cache baseline and up to 38% additional speedup over a conservative fixed-threshold baseline. Reported quality changes are small: less than 0.3 dB PSNR drop, less than 0.01 SSIM drop, and less than 0.01 LPIPS increase. The main empirical claim is that avoiding aggressive caching at critical steps improves the latency-quality tradeoff compared with any single fixed threshold.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the fixed-threshold failure mode, then the ACID method section for the definitions of accumulated drift, critical steps, and adaptive low/high thresholds. In the experiments, focus on the Pareto frontier plots, the per-method generalization across TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache, and the quality metric tables. For LLM pretraining work, the video-specific engineering details can be skipped unless the target system includes diffusion-based multimodal generation or serving-time dynamic compute.

recommendation.zh: 扩散推理缓存的核心洞察是关键步非均匀阈值，对统一AR+diffusion多模态基座的推理侧优化有参考，只看方法部分关键步识别逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: The core insight of non-uniform thresholds across critical denoising steps is useful for inference optimization of unified AR+diffusion multimodal foundations; read only the critical-step identification logic in the method section.

paper.title: Gen4U: Unifying Video Generation and Understanding via Diffusion
paper.abstract: Prior work suggests that diffusion representations capture low-level geometry but struggle with high-level semantics. We demonstrate that state-of-the-art video diffusion models overcome this limitation. By systematically probing their intermediate activations using recent mutual-kNN alignment metrics, we reveal a highly structured latent space where visual representations evolve across both network depth and noise levels. We show that while moderate noise levels yield linearly separable global

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：视频扩散模型的中间表示能否不只服务生成，也能作为通用视频理解表征，并且避免多步去噪带来的高推理成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把生成式视频预训练的表示能力重新拉回到“可复用表征”这个问题上。过去常见判断是扩散特征偏几何和纹理，高层语义不如对比学习或视觉语言模型。这里的结果显示，更强的视频扩散或 flow-matching 模型在合适的网络层和噪声水平上，可以产生可线性分离的全局语义；在低噪声区域保留更细的几何细节，但这些细节更分散，需要 attention pooling 之类的读出机制。这个结论对统一生成与理解的多模态预训练有参考价值：预训练目标不一定要显式做分类或图文对齐，生成模型内部也可能形成可迁移的语义与几何层级。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是表示探测：作者分析 Veo3 和 Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 这类视频生成模型，在不同网络深度和不同噪声水平下的中间激活，用 mutual k-NN alignment 等零样本对齐指标刻画 latent space 的结构。核心观察是，表示不是单调地“越深越语义”或“噪声越低越好”，而是存在任务相关的最佳区域。中等噪声水平更适合提取全局语义；低噪声水平保留细粒度时空和几何信息，但空间上更分散，简单平均池化不够，需要带注意力的读出器。第二步是 Gen4U：固定扩散或 flow backbone，只在选定 block 和 noise level 做一次前向计算，然后接轻量 decoder 完成分类、caption、深度、相机位姿等任务。它和直接用扩散模型做多步生成再理解不同，关键是把“去噪轨迹”压缩成一次特征抽取，因此推理成本接近普通判别式视频 encoder。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类模型：专有的 Veo3，以及开源权重的 Wan2.2-T2V-A14B。任务覆盖语义和几何两端，包括零样本 alignment、Something-Something V2 视频分类、图像/视频 captioning、单目深度估计和相机位姿估计。主要结论是：冻结的视频扩散表示在高层视频语义任务上表现强，尤其在 Something-Something V2 这类动作和时序关系要求较高的数据集上能体现时序理解能力；同一套表示也能支持深度和相机位姿这类几何任务。消融的重点不是单个 decoder 的复杂度，而是 block、noise level、pooling/readout 方式对结果的影响。论文给出的机制解释是：语义信息在中等噪声阶段更集中、更容易线性读出；几何细节在低噪声阶段更完整，但需要空间敏感的读出方式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看 latent manifold 分析部分，尤其是 depth × noise level 的表示对齐图和不同读出方式的消融。Gen4U 的方法部分要关注两个设计：为什么只需要一次 forward pass，以及如何选择特征抽取位置。实验部分优先看 Something-Something V2、depth、pose 三类任务表格，因为它们分别检验时序语义、局部几何和相机运动。若关心预训练范式，值得深挖的问题是：扩散训练目标形成的语义层级是否稳定随模型规模增强，以及这种表示能否替代或补充视觉语言对齐预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether modern video diffusion models can serve as general-purpose video encoders, not just generators, while avoiding the cost of iterative denoising at inference time.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining is the representation question. Earlier analyses often found diffusion features useful for geometry but weak for high-level semantics. This work argues that stronger video diffusion and flow-matching backbones have a more structured internal representation space: global semantics become linearly accessible at suitable intermediate noise levels, while fine-grained geometry is preserved at lower noise levels but needs a more spatially aware readout. This matters for unified generation-and-understanding pretraining, because it suggests that a generative video objective can produce reusable semantic and geometric features without adding an explicit discriminative objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first probes intermediate activations from Veo3 and Wan2.2-T2V-A14B across model depth and noise level. It uses zero-shot mutual k-NN alignment metrics and lightweight trained probes to map where different types of information appear. The key finding is not simply that deeper layers are better. The useful representation depends on both depth and corruption level. Moderate noise levels expose more globally separable semantic features. Lower noise levels preserve details, but those details are spatially scattered, so simple pooling loses information and attention-based decoding is more effective. Gen4U then turns this analysis into a feature extraction pipeline: freeze the generative backbone, choose an appropriate block and noise level, run a single forward pass, and train lightweight task decoders. This differs from using the diffusion model through a full denoising trajectory; the expensive generation process is replaced by one representation extraction pass.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers a proprietary model, Veo3, and an open-weight model, Wan2.2-T2V-A14B. Tasks include zero-shot representation alignment, video classification on Something-Something V2, image and video captioning, monocular depth estimation, and camera pose estimation. The reported pattern is consistent across semantic and geometric tasks: frozen generative video features can support high-level temporal understanding while also retaining low-level geometry. The most informative ablations are the feature-source studies over block index, noise level, and pooling or decoder design. The central empirical message is that semantic readout prefers intermediate-noise features, whereas geometry benefits from lower-noise features and spatially sensitive attention-based decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Focus on the latent-space analysis, especially the heatmaps or tables crossing network depth with noise level. Then read the Gen4U extraction design: the single-forward-pass setup and the rule for choosing feature locations. In the experiments, prioritize Something-Something V2, depth estimation, and camera pose estimation, since they test temporal semantics, local geometry, and camera motion. For pretraining researchers, the deeper question is whether these representation properties scale predictably with generative model capability, and whether diffusion pretraining can reduce the need for separate discriminative video encoders.

recommendation.zh: 系统分析视频扩散模型的表征结构，对理解扩散模型语义能力有参考价值，对Diffusion LM研究有间接启发，重点看表征分析部分
recommendation.en: Systematic analysis of video diffusion model representations; valuable for understanding diffusion semantic capabilities, with indirect insights for Diffusion LM research

summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率与模型压缩系统工作。它对 LLM 预训练本身不直接，但 recurrent reformulation、chunk-wise generation、constant-memory attention 和结构化压缩，对长序列生成模型的部署形态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从 Wan2.2-5B 出发，使用 recurrence distillation 把视频生成改写为 chunk-wise autoregressive process，使模型在推理时以近似 RNN 的方式处理视频片段；结合 causal linear attention 做常量内存注意力计算，并通过可学习或结构化压缩降低移动端部署开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明现有移动视频 diffusion 多在 0.4B 到 1.8B 参数量，而该工作尝试部署 5B 参数视频 diffusion transformer。具体训练数据、压缩比例、移动端延迟和质量指标未在给定摘要中完整列出。
summary.authors_note: 题目信息标注为 Cohere 相关工作；Fatih Porikli 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者，Markus Nagel 在模型压缩和量化方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to deploy a 5B-parameter video diffusion transformer on memory-constrained mobile hardware while preserving generation quality and temporal coherence.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and compression systems contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its recurrent reformulation, chunk-wise generation, constant-memory attention, and structured compression are relevant to long-sequence generative deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from Wan2.2-5B, the method uses recurrence distillation to turn video generation into a chunk-wise autoregressive process. Causal linear attention gives constant-memory computation, so the model behaves like an RNN at inference time while carrying temporal state across chunks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract contrasts prior mobile video diffusion models in the 0.4B–1.8B range with a 5B video diffusion transformer. Detailed training data, compression ratios, latency, and quality metrics are not fully available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks the work as associated with Cohere. Fatih Porikli is a well-known computer vision researcher, and Markus Nagel is known for work on model compression and quantization.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；看 recurrence distillation 和常量内存注意力设置，判断能否迁移到长上下文生成。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the recurrence distillation and constant-memory attention setup for long-context generation transfer.

paper.title: Reward Lightning: Fast Video Generation via Homologous Preference Distillation
paper.abstract: Achieving simultaneous preference alignment and distillation acceleration in video diffusion models remains an open challenge. Existing methods optimize the two objectives over mismatched representation spaces, where improving one objective often compromises the other. To overcome this, we propose Reward Lightning, a unified framework that aligns and accelerates a video diffusion model within a single shared representation. Its central principle is homology: both objectives are evaluated on iden

summary.core_problem: 解决视频扩散模型中“偏好对齐”和“少步蒸馏加速”互相冲突的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成模型的训练目标整合。它试图把 reward alignment 和 distillation 放到同一个 latent 表示空间中，减少两个目标在不同表征上优化时产生的梯度冲突。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Reward Lightning。核心是 latent reward model，直接在视频 latent 特征上打分，避免解码到像素空间后再评估；随后用 homologous preference distillation 复用共享 backbone，把 adversarial distillation 和 preference alignment 联合训练。方法属于对现有视频扩散蒸馏和偏好优化的组合式改进，关键点是共享 latent feature。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和完整数值。宣称得到 few-step video generators，同时保持较好的偏好对齐和生成质量，但需要正文确认是否有干净的消融来证明“同源表示”确实降低了梯度冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the conflict between preference alignment and few-step distillation in video diffusion models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training-objective integration for multimodal generation. The main idea is to optimize reward alignment and distillation in the same latent representation, instead of evaluating them in mismatched feature spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reward Lightning introduces a latent reward model that scores videos directly in latent space, avoiding pixel-space decoding for reward evaluation. Homologous preference distillation then reuses the shared backbone to jointly perform adversarial distillation and preference alignment. The novelty is mostly in coupling these objectives through shared latent features.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, detailed baselines, or quantitative gains. It claims few-step video generators with maintained fidelity and preference alignment, but the key evidence should be whether ablations isolate the effect of shared latent features on gradient conflict.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练只算旁支；若做 diffusion 对齐蒸馏，可看 latent reward 和梯度冲突消融，别把视频指标当通用结论。
recommendation.en: Peripheral for LLM pretraining; useful only if you care about diffusion alignment-distillation, and the gradient-conflict ablations matter more than the video metrics.

As a result, achieving desired motion often requires extensive prompt engineering and repeated resampling. summary.core_problem: 在不微调视频扩散 Transformer 的情况下，用用户给定的物体形变或光流实现可控视频运动生成。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成控制方法，不是 LLM 预训练论文；价值在于它直接操作 DiT 的 attention/query 表示，提供了一个观察视频 DiT 内部语义与运动解耦的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 QWERTY，一个 training-free 控制框架。方法不改模型权重，而是在预训练 image-to-video DiT 的 3D full attention 中，对 query 的帧不变语义子空间做 warping，使用户定义的 object warping 或 optical flow 能影响后续噪声预测与运动轨迹。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 或量化提升；对比对象主要是需要额外空间提示微调的方法，以及已有 U-Net 视频扩散中的 training-free 控制方法。
summary.authors_note: 标注信息显示该工作与 Cohere 有关；摘要未提供更具体的作者机构分工。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper enables user-specified motion control in video diffusion transformers without fine-tuning the pretrained model.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation control method rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its useful signal is the direct manipulation of DiT attention/query representations, which gives a concrete probe into semantic-motion factorization in video DiTs.
summary_en.technical_approach: QWERTY is a training-free framework for pretrained image-to-video DiTs. Instead of updating weights, it warps the frame-invariant semantic subspace of queries inside 3D full attention, using object warping or optical flow to steer the model's noise prediction and motion generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model names, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant comparison is against fine-tuning-based spatial-control methods and training-free control methods previously explored mainly for U-Net video diffusion models.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided metadata marks Cohere as a strong affiliated institution; the abstract itself does not specify detailed affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 不影响 LLM 训练路线；若关心 DiT 表示，只看 query warping 机制和 attention ablation。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining-route paper; read only the query-warping mechanism and attention ablations if you study DiT representations.

paper.title: W4A4 Quantization for Inference on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B
paper.abstract: We summarize our submission to Sub-Challenge 1: W4A4 Quantization for Inference (HiF4 / MXFP4) of the ICME 2026 Low-Bit-width Large-Model Quantization Challenge. The sub-challenge targets 4-bit weight and 4-bit activation inference on Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B under HiF4 or MXFP4 numerical formats. summary.core_problem: 解决 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 在 4-bit 权重与 4-bit 激活约束下的推理量化问题，尽量保住视频生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率工程：把 LLM 量化里的 mixed precision outlier 处理和 SmoothQuant 思路迁移到视频生成模型。对基座研究的价值主要在跨模态量化经验，而不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法组合了三部分：用校准批次识别重尾激活通道；用 SmoothQuant 风格的 per-channel smoothing 重平衡动态范围；对异常列采用 MixQ 风格双分支高精度保留，其余通道严格 W4A4，并配合 block-wise HiF4 packing 优化前馈层推理。
summary.experiments: 对象模型是 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，校准数据来自 OpenS2V-5M 代表性 batch。摘要称在官方 VBench I2V 指标上，大多数质量维度相对 FP16 仅退化 2%-3.5%，优于原生 HiFloat4 baseline 约 5% 的退化，并在 motion smoothness 上有提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets 4-bit weight and 4-bit activation inference for Wan2.2-I2V-A14B while trying to preserve video generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency engineering paper. Its value comes from porting LLM quantization ideas to a video diffusion model, not from advancing pretraining methodology itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines three ingredients: calibration-based detection of heavy-tailed activation channels, SmoothQuant-style per-channel smoothing to rebalance dynamic range, and a MixQ-like dual-branch path that keeps outlier columns in higher precision while the rest stays in strict W4A4, plus block-wise HiF4 packing for FFN layers.
summary_en.experiments: The target model is Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, calibrated on representative OpenS2V-5M batches. On official VBench I2V metrics, the method reportedly stays within 2%-3.5% of FP16 on most quality axes, outperforming a native HiFloat4 baseline that degrades by roughly 5%, with improved motion smoothness.

recommendation.zh: 是个像样的量化移植案例，但更像比赛工程总结；只看 outlier 处理和 smoothing 组合是否真能跨到 DiT，别指望有新的训练侧 insight。
recommendation.en: A decent quantization transfer case, but it reads more like challenge engineering; check whether the outlier-plus-smoothing recipe really carries over to DiTs, not for new training-side insight.

summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法：把视频 diffusion 的 feature evolution 建模为测试时自校准的状态估计问题，减少对离线 calibration data 的依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NaviCache，一个 plug-and-play test-time self-calibration caching 方法。它把特征演化类比为惯性导航系统，跟踪输入变化与输出变化之间的相对耦合，并用 dual-state estimation 同时估计 feature change ratio 及其潜在漂移。

summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for video generation. It reframes feature caching as a test-time self-calibrated state estimation problem, avoiding heavy offline calibration.
