paper.title: Causal-rCM: A Unified Teacher-Forcing and Self-Forcing Open Recipe for Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation in Streaming Video Generation and Interactive World Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion with causal diffusion transformers has emerged as a major paradigm for real-time streaming video generation and action-conditioned interactive world models. In this work, we extend rCM, an advanced diffusion distillation framework, to autoregressive video diffusion. The core philosophy of rCM lies in the complementarity between forward and reverse divergences, represented by consistency models (CMs) and distribution matching distillation (DMD), respectively, in dif

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是自回归视频扩散蒸馏里的一个老问题：训练时看到的条件分布和推理时模型自己滚动生成出来的分布不一致，导致长时生成里误差累积、画质下滑、动作漂移。已有做法通常分成两段：先用 teacher-forcing 或 diffusion-forcing 做一个稳定初始化，再切到 self-forcing 配合 DMD/GAN 做 on-policy 蒸馏。但这些系统往往是经验拼装，为什么要这样分阶段、不同初始化各自解决什么问题、CM 与 DMD 在 AR diffusion 里如何互补，并没有被系统讲清楚。Causal-rCM 试图把这件事统一起来：用 teacher-forcing consistency model 提供覆盖更全、训练更稳的离线信号，再用 self-forcing DMD 对齐真实推理时的少步采样分布。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在视频生成本身，而在于它把“前向/离线目标负责稳定与覆盖，反向/on-policy目标负责贴近生成分布”这个训练原则，明确落到了 AR diffusion distillation 上。这个思路和语言模型里的 pretrain ↔ post-train、offline imitation ↔ online refinement 有明显同构关系。另一点更实际：作者给出了 teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency training 的工程实现，包括自定义 mask 的 FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel，并声称相对离散时间 CM 有 10× 收敛加速。这部分对做新型 LM 范式、尤其是 any-order / diffusion LM 的训练基础设施有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两层统一。第一层是目标函数视角：CM 被视为更偏 forward-divergence、保轨迹、mode-covering 的目标；DMD 被视为更偏 reverse-divergence、直接优化学生生成分布的目标。第二层是因果训练范式视角：teacher-forcing 对应离线、稳定、覆盖教师轨迹；self-forcing 对应 on-policy、直接暴露推理时误差。Causal-rCM 把两者配对起来，形成 teacher-forcing CM + self-forcing DMD 的组合。

更具体地说，teacher-forcing CM 阶段在真实因果上下文和教师轨迹上做 few-step causal distillation，让学生先学会在“正确历史”条件下稳定地少步去噪；随后 self-forcing DMD 阶段让学生在自己生成的 rollout 上继续优化，缩小训练-推理 gap。作者强调这两部分既可以联合训练，也可以按 forward-to-reverse 的顺序分阶段训练。

论文还系统比较了 self-forcing DMD 的不同初始化来源，包括 ODE-pair regression、diffusion-forcing 风格因果适配、hybrid TF/DF 初始化，以及他们主张的 TF-CM 初始化。作者的判断是：如果直接上 reverse/on-policy 目标，容易因为覆盖不足和初始化差而塌缩；先用 forward/offline 目标把轨迹空间铺开，再切到 DMD，稳定性和最终质量都更好。

工程上最值得注意的是 continuous-time consistency model 的实现。文中提到此前 AR diffusion 里更多用 discrete-time CM，而他们实现了 teacher-forcing 版本的 sCM / MeanFlow，并用自定义 mask 的 FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel 支持连续时间训练。这说明作者不只是换了 loss，而是把 AR causal mask、consistency training、JVP 计算图和高效注意力内核打通了。
summary.experiments:
从引言能确认的实验结论有三类。第一，训练效率：teacher-forcing continuous-time CM 相比 discrete-time CM 达到约 10× 更快收敛，这是全文里最明确、也最有工程含义的数字。第二，方法比较：作者声称做了对 self-forcing DMD 初始化策略的系统研究，并展示不同初始化各有优缺点，而 TF-CM 初始化更稳、更适合作为统一 recipe。第三，整体性能：文中将 Causal-rCM 描述为在 AR diffusion distillation 上达到领先结果，面向 streaming video generation 和 interactive world model 场景。

但就当前给出的全文片段，还拿不到完整的主表数字、模型参数量、训练数据规模、采样步数、具体 benchmark 名称，也看不到消融表的精确提升幅度。因此这篇更适合先抓方法框架和训练原则，再在正式阅读时补齐实验细节，尤其是：1）不同初始化在 FVD、长时一致性、rollout 稳定性上的差异；2）joint training 与 two-stage training 的对比；3）continuous-time 与 discrete-time CM 在 wall-clock、显存、吞吐上的真实代价。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Table 1，抓住作者要统一的三件事：causal training paradigm、distillation loss、initialization strategy。然后重点看方法部分里 teacher-forcing CM 与 self-forcing DMD 的接口定义，弄清楚训练数据来自教师轨迹还是学生 rollout，各自优化的分布是什么。接着看 continuous-time CM 的实现细节，尤其是 custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel，这部分最可能对做新型预训练范式的人有迁移价值。

实验部分建议优先看三类图表：初始化策略对比、continuous-time vs discrete-time 收敛曲线、长时 rollout 质量随时间退化的分析。如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若要深挖，重点不是视频指标本身，而是 forward/offline objective 与 reverse/on-policy objective 的分工边界，这个抽象层次更值得带回到 LM 训练里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central failure mode in autoregressive video diffusion distillation: the mismatch between training-time conditioning and inference-time self-generated rollouts. Teacher-forcing and diffusion-forcing provide stable supervision, but they do not expose the model to its own rollout errors. Self-forcing addresses exposure bias, yet DMD- or GAN-based on-policy distillation is fragile, highly initialization-sensitive, and prone to collapse. Causal-rCM tries to turn this from an ad hoc recipe into a principled training scheme by pairing an offline, mode-covering consistency objective with an on-policy distribution-matching objective.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about video generation per se and more about the training principle it makes explicit: offline/forward objectives are useful for coverage and stability, while on-policy/reverse objectives are useful for matching the actual generated distribution. That pattern is highly relevant to non-AR language modeling, diffusion LM training, and even the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The infrastructure contribution also matters: the paper implements teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency training for causal AR diffusion with a custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel, and reports roughly 10x faster convergence than discrete-time CMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method unifies two complementary views. At the objective level, consistency models are treated as forward-divergence-like, trajectory-preserving, and mode-covering, whereas DMD is treated as reverse-divergence-like and directly aligned with the student-generated distribution. At the causal training level, teacher-forcing plays the role of stable offline supervision on teacher trajectories, while self-forcing plays the role of on-policy refinement under autoregressive rollouts.

Causal-rCM combines them as teacher-forcing CM plus self-forcing DMD. In the first part, the student learns few-step causal distillation on offline causal contexts and teacher trajectories, which gives a stable initialization under correct histories. In the second part, the student is optimized on its own rollouts so that the distilled few-step sampler better matches inference-time behavior. The paper argues that this complementarity can be realized either jointly or in a staged forward-to-reverse schedule.

A useful part of the paper is its systematic treatment of initialization for self-forcing DMD. It compares several existing choices, including ODE-pair regression, diffusion-forcing-style causal adaptation, and hybrid TF/DF initialization, against TF-CM initialization. The claimed takeaway is that reverse/on-policy optimization alone is too brittle when coverage is poor, while a forward/offline consistency stage provides a much better basin for subsequent DMD refinement.

The engineering layer is also nontrivial. The authors implement teacher-forcing continuous-time consistency models, including sCM and MeanFlow variants, in an autoregressive causal-mask setting. The custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel is the key systems piece that makes this practical. That is likely the most transferable part for researchers working on alternative language-modeling paradigms.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text portion, three experimental claims are clear. First, training efficiency: teacher-forcing continuous-time CM converges about 10x faster than discrete-time CM. This is the most concrete quantitative result visible in the available text. Second, the paper performs a systematic study of initialization strategies for self-forcing DMD and argues that TF-CM initialization is more stable and more suitable as a unified recipe. Third, the overall method is presented as a leading open recipe for AR diffusion distillation in streaming video generation and interactive world models.

What is not recoverable from the current excerpt are the full benchmark tables, model sizes, dataset scales, sampling-step configurations, and exact gains on headline metrics. So the paper is better read first for its training decomposition and only then for detailed numbers. When reading the experiments in full, the most important checks are: differences among initialization strategies on rollout stability and long-horizon quality, joint versus two-stage training, and the real wall-clock and memory trade-offs of continuous-time versus discrete-time consistency training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the summary table of related methods. The key is to understand the three-way alignment the paper is proposing: causal training paradigm, distillation loss, and initialization strategy. Then read the method section with one concrete question in mind: which distributions are optimized in teacher-forcing CM versus self-forcing DMD, and where exactly does the training-inference gap get reduced?

After that, go to the implementation details of continuous-time consistency training, especially the custom-mask FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel. That section is likely more reusable than the video-specific parts. In the experiments, prioritize the initialization ablations, continuous-time versus discrete-time convergence plots, and long-horizon rollout degradation analyses. A practical skim should take around 25–35 minutes. If reading more deeply, focus on the division of labor between forward/offline and reverse/on-policy objectives rather than on video metrics alone.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 TF-CM 初始化 SF-DMD 的实验；它可能改变对 AR 生成中 teacher forcing 是否只是训练捷径的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the TF-CM-to-SF-DMD ablation; it may update the prior that teacher forcing is merely a training shortcut in AR generation.

paper.title: CoDMD: Copula-aware Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Video Generation
paper.abstract: Few-step distillation for video diffusion models has attracted significant attention, driven by the urgent demand for efficient deployment in real-world scenarios. However, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), a leading paradigm, tends to degrade under limited NFE budgets, manifesting in video generation as layout instability, oversaturation, and broken motion dynamics. We trace this failure to a structural limitation: standard DMD is an intra-sample distribution-matching objective with coo

summary.core_problem: 解决视频扩散模型少步蒸馏中，DMD 在低 NFE 预算下容易出现布局不稳、过饱和和运动动力学破碎的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型蒸馏目标的改进。它把 DMD 的失败归因到缺少跨样本和跨时间帧的关系约束，而不只是单帧质量或采样器设计问题；对视频生成部署有工程意义，但与 LLM 基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Copula-aware Distribution Matching Distillation。核心做法是在标准 DMD 的分布匹配损失外加入轻量级关系正则，复用已有 score estimates，对 batch 元素和时间帧之间的 copula/依赖结构施加约束，以缓解 reverse-KL 的 mode-seeking 倾向和局部坍缩。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据集、NFE 设置或数值提升。实验声称在 few-step 视频生成设置中改善布局稳定性、颜色饱和问题和运动一致性，并优于标准 DMD 类蒸馏方法。
summary.authors_note: Jiaya Jia 是计算机视觉和图像/视频处理领域知名研究者；其团队长期做生成、编辑和视觉恢复相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures of DMD-based few-step distillation for video diffusion models, including unstable layouts, oversaturation, and broken motion dynamics under very small NFE budgets.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an objective-level modification for generative model distillation. Its useful point is the diagnosis that DMD lacks explicit relational constraints across samples and temporal frames, rather than treating the issue as only a sampler or per-frame quality problem. It is engineering-relevant for video generation, but only peripheral to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Copula-aware DMD, augments standard distribution matching distillation with a lightweight relational regularizer. It reuses score estimates already computed by DMD and regularizes the copula-like dependency geometry across batch elements and video frames, aiming to counter the mode-seeking behavior of reverse-KL distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, datasets, exact NFE budgets, or numerical gains. It reports improved temporal stability, layout preservation, color behavior, and motion dynamics over standard DMD-style baselines in few-step video generation.
summary_en.authors_note: Jiaya Jia is a well-known researcher in computer vision and image/video processing, with prior work spanning generation, editing, and restoration.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法动机即可；copula 视角对 diffusion 蒸馏有一点新意，但离语言建模和基座训练较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the motivation; the copula view is mildly useful for diffusion distillation, but it is far from language-model pretraining.

paper.title: Vera: A Layered Diffusion Model for Content-Preserving Video Editing
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have enabled remarkable progress in video generation and editing. However, content preservation remains a core challenge: existing methods regenerate every pixel and often alter elements that should remain unchanged, such as characters or background scenes. We introduce Vera, a layered diffusion framework for content-preserving video editing. Instead of regenerating the entire video, Vera generates an edit layer along with an alpha matte for compositing with the source vid

summary.core_problem: 解决视频编辑中扩散模型重生成整段视频、容易破坏未编辑主体和背景的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法创新和数据构建。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但 layered generation、alpha compositing 和多 Transformer 交互结构对视频生成模型设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Vera，一个分层视频扩散框架：不直接重生成所有像素，而是生成编辑层和 alpha matte，再与源视频合成。模型上把 text-to-video DiT 扩展为 Mixture-of-Transformers，不同层使用独立 DiT，并通过 joint self-attention 交互。训练侧构建带准确 alpha matte、场景和动态多样的 layered video dataset。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在定量 benchmark 和人类偏好评测中优于现有视频编辑方法，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Yisong Yue 是机器学习和决策系统方向的知名研究者；摘要未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles content drift in video editing, where diffusion models regenerate every pixel and unintentionally alter characters, objects, or backgrounds that should remain unchanged.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method and dataset contribution. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but the layered generation design and the interaction pattern between multiple DiTs are relevant for researchers tracking video foundation-model architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Vera generates an edit layer and an alpha matte, then composites the result with the source video instead of regenerating the full frame. It extends text-to-video DiT into a Mixture-of-Transformers design, with separate DiTs per layer that communicate through joint self-attention. The authors also build a layered dataset with accurate alpha mattes and diverse scenes and dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports gains on quantitative benchmarks and human-preference evaluations, but does not provide model scale, dataset size, baseline names, or exact improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Yisong Yue is a well-known researcher in machine learning and decision systems; the provided metadata does not confirm full affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线；只看分层 DiT 和 joint attention 设计，判断它是否能迁移到统一视频生成。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the layered DiT and joint-attention design only if you track transferable video-generation architectures.

paper.title: Through the PRISM: Preference Representation in Intermediate States of Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Evaluating video generation with clean, pixel-based reward models disconnects evaluation from the noisy diffusion process and incurs massive VAE decoding costs. In this paper, we challenge this paradigm by asking a fundamental question: Can a powerful video generator inherently discriminate preferences directly from noisy latents? To answer this, we introduce \textbf{PRISM} (\textbf{P}reference \textbf{R}epresentation in \textbf{I}ntermediate \textbf{S}tates of Diffusion \textbf{M}odels). PRISM

summary.core_problem: 现有视频扩散模型的偏好评估依赖解码后的像素级奖励模型，与扩散过程的噪声潜变量脱节，且VAE解码成本高。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出直接从扩散中间噪声潜变量中提取偏好信号的评估范式，同时实现早期Best-of-N采样以降低计算成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PRISM框架，冻结视频扩散主干，新增轻量Query-based聚合头，从不同时间步的噪声潜变量中解码偏好信号；利用噪声鲁棒性在去噪早期过滤劣质候选。
summary.experiments: 在视频生成偏好评估任务上取得SOTA准确率；支持早期Best-of-N采样，显著降低计算量同时提升生成视频质量；验证了主干能力与偏好表示的正相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing preference evaluation for video diffusion relies on pixel-level reward models on decoded outputs, which is disconnected from noisy diffusion latents and incurs high VAE decoding cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first paradigm that extracts preference signals directly from intermediate noisy diffusion latents, enabling early Best-of-N sampling to cut compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRISM framework freezes the video diffusion backbone and attaches a lightweight query-based aggregation head to decode preference from noisy latents across timesteps; leverages noise robustness to filter bad candidates early in denoising.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves SOTA preference accuracy on video generation evaluation; early Best-of-N sampling reduces compute substantially while improving video quality; verifies positive correlation between backbone capability and preference representation strength.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散偏好评估的新思路，早期剪枝采样的思路可迁移到文本扩散/MDLM的推理成本优化，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Novel take on preference evaluation for video diffusion; early-pruning sampling idea is transferable to inference cost reduction in text diffusion / MDLM, read the method section only.

paper.title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this

summary.core_problem: 基于反向KL的视频扩散模型少步蒸馏方法（如DMD/DMD2）存在样本多样性下降（模式崩溃）和输出过饱和、偏离真实视频分布的两大缺陷。
summary.importance: 提出极简的蒸馏后训练框架，仅需单行代码修改即可缓解DMD类方法的核心缺陷，对扩散模型少步蒸馏有通用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Data-Forcing Distillation（DFD），在原有DMD损失基础上引入教师分数差异项，引导学生模型向真实数据分布移动，一方面补充缺失的生成模式（缓解模式崩溃），另一方面拉离真实数据中不存在的错误模式（缓解过饱和），配套理论分析解释框架有效性。
summary.experiments: 在文本到视频生成任务上验证，相比DMD/DMD2基线，少步生成设置下显著提升样本多样性与视觉保真度，缓解输出过饱和问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step video diffusion distillation methods based on reverse KL (e.g., DMD/DMD2) suffer from two persistent failure modes: reduced sample diversity from mode collapse, and over-saturated outputs that deviate from real video distributions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an extremely simple post-training distillation framework that mitigates both core flaws of DMD-style methods with a single line of code change, offering general insights for few-step diffusion distillation across domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD) adds a teacher score discrepancy term to the standard DMD loss, guiding the student model toward the real data distribution to cover missing modes (reducing mode collapse) and push away from spurious modes absent in real data (reducing over-saturation), supported by theoretical analysis of the objective.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-video generation tasks, showing significant improvements in sample diversity and visual fidelity under few-step settings compared to DMD/DMD2 baselines, with reduced output over-saturation.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散蒸馏的极简损失改进，缓解反向KL导致的mode collapse，做扩散LM蒸馏可参考其损失设计
recommendation.en: A simple loss fix for reverse-KL induced mode collapse in video diffusion distillation; worth checking the loss design if you work on diffusive LM distillation.

paper.title: Pulling The REINS: Training-Free Safety Alignment of Video Diffusion Models via Representation Steering
paper.abstract: Open-weight video diffusion models can generate photorealistic unsafe content, from violence to misinformation, yet existing defenses either require expensive safety fine-tuning that degrades general capability, or apply external filters that are trivially bypassed by adversarial prompts. We present REINS (REpresentation-space INference-time Safety steering), a training-free method that aligns video diffusion models at inference time by steering their internal representations toward safe generat

summary.core_problem: 在不微调视频扩散模型的情况下，降低开放权重视频生成模型产生暴力、误导等不安全内容的概率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型安全与表示操控方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但“安全属性在隐藏状态中近似线性可分、可用单方向 steering 控制”的结论，对 activation steering 和生成模型对齐有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: REINS 先用带二元安全标签的样本，通过 Supervised PCA 在视频 diffusion transformer 的 hidden states 中找出安全方向；推理时在中间 transformer 层把该方向加到隐藏状态上，将不安全生成轨迹重定向为语义相关的安全替代内容。方法不更新权重，也不依赖枚举危险概念或外部过滤器。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频模型、数据规模、baseline 数值或安全性/画质指标提升；只说明方法面向 open-weight video diffusion models，并声称避免安全微调带来的能力退化和外部过滤器易绕过问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce unsafe generations from open-weight video diffusion models without safety fine-tuning or external filtering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety and representation-steering method for generative video models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the claim that safety is linearly encoded in hidden states is relevant to activation steering and alignment mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: REINS finds a safety direction in hidden-state activations using Supervised PCA on binary safety labels. At inference time, it adds this direction to an intermediate transformer layer to redirect unsafe trajectories toward semantically related safe outputs, without weight updates, concept enumeration, or external filters.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model names, dataset size, baselines, or numerical gains. It frames the method as a training-free alternative to safety fine-tuning and filter-based defenses for open-weight video diffusion models.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；若做 activation steering，只看线性安全方向的构造和插入层选择，结论需等完整实验验证。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; if you work on activation steering, inspect the safety-direction construction and layer choice, but wait for full experiments.

paper.title: Temporal Backtracking Search for Test-time Generative Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: While test-time scaling has revolutionized reasoning in large language models, generative video reasoning remains bottlenecked by a single-shot paradigm. We demonstrate that searching over denoising steps cannot rescue logically flawed rollouts because spatial trajectories commit early in the diffusion process. Root-level Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is similarly inefficient: reasoning errors cluster early in the temporal axis, and resampling blindly discards verified upstream progress. To unlock ef

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是生成式视频模型在长程推理任务中的测试时扩展问题：如果视频 rollout 早期走错，继续在去噪步骤上加计算，或者从根节点反复 Best-of-N 采样，都很难高效修正逻辑错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对“视频模型作为世界模型”的推理接口有启发。论文把测试时计算从扩散去噪轴转移到时间轴，说明视频生成中的推理错误更像序列决策错误，而不是单纯的视觉质量或 prompt alignment 问题。这个观察对跨模态生成模型、world model、以及未来把视频 rollout 接入 agent planning 的系统有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Temporal Backtracking Search，简称 TBS。它不把一段视频当作不可分割的完整样本，而是维护一组已经验证过的时间前缀。模型先生成完整或部分 rollout， verifier 找到第一个逻辑失败帧，然后保留失败前的有效前缀，从该前缀重新生成后续视频。为此，模型需要 variable-K conditioning：可以从任意长度的干净前缀继续生成，并保留已有运动上下文。TBS 的三个关键组件是：前缀条件生成、过程级时间验证器、基于优先队列的前缀搜索。它和常规 BoN 的区别在于，BoN 每次失败都丢掉整个 rollout；TBS 只丢掉错误后缀，把计算集中在未解决的未来部分。
summary.experiments: 论文在三类设置中验证方法：符号 grid-world，用精确规则验证；连续导航，用学习得到的轨迹预测器做有噪声验证；机器人操作，用 simulator replay 做物理验证。主要结论是，在相同测试时预算下，TBS 相比根节点 BoN 有更好的成功率和计算效率。一个关键数字是，在严格 OOD 设置中，BoN 的 exact match 只有 0.7%，TBS 达到 22.7%，且所有成功样例都来自 restart 后的 child branch。论文还用中间 latent 解码说明，高层空间轨迹在扩散早期已经基本确定，因此沿 denoising step 搜索很难修复早期逻辑错误。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中两个 empirical bottleneck：早期轨迹承诺和错误在时间轴早段聚集。然后看 Section 3.1 的 conditional reuse gap，它解释了为什么修复后缀比从头生成更容易。Section 3.2–3.3 是方法核心，重点关注 variable-K conditioning 如何支持任意前缀续写。实验部分建议看 OOD 结果、matched-budget BoN 对比，以及不同 verifier 假设下的表现。需要留意的是，这篇工作的收益依赖可用的过程验证器；如果 verifier 很弱或无法定位 first failure frame，TBS 的优势会下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses test-time scaling for generative video reasoning. The key issue is that once a generated video takes a wrong early trajectory, adding compute along the denoising axis or resampling whole videos with Best-of-N is an inefficient way to repair the logical error.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining contribution, but it is useful for researchers thinking about video models as world models. It reframes video test-time scaling as temporal search over partially verified rollouts, rather than refinement over diffusion steps. This matters for multimodal agents that use generated videos for planning, where trajectory correctness is more important than visual fidelity.
summary_en.technical_approach: Temporal Backtracking Search turns video generation into a generate–verify–restart loop. A rollout is checked by a process verifier, which identifies the first failing frame. The valid prefix before that frame is kept as a restart anchor, and the model regenerates only the suffix. The method relies on variable-K conditioning, a training setup that lets the diffusion model resume generation from clean prefixes of arbitrary temporal length while preserving motion context. Compared with root-level Best-of-N, TBS avoids throwing away correct early progress and reallocates inference budget to unresolved suffixes.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers symbolic grid-worlds with exact verification, continuous navigation with learned noisy trajectory verification, and robotic manipulation with simulator-replay verification. Under matched inference budgets, TBS consistently improves the success–compute tradeoff over root-level Best-of-N. The most informative result is the strict OOD case: Best-of-N reaches only 0.7% exact match, while TBS reaches 22.7%, and all solved cases come from restarted child branches. The paper also reports that high-level spatial trajectories are committed in the earliest denoising steps, which explains why denoising-step search is poorly matched to logical repair.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the empirical observations in the introduction and Figure 1, since they motivate the shift from denoising-step search to temporal search. Then read Sections 3.1–3.3 for the conditional reuse gap, the search algorithm, and variable-K conditioning. In the experiments, focus on the OOD setting, the matched-budget comparison with Best-of-N, and the sensitivity to different verifier types. The main caveat is verifier dependence: the method is strongest when failures can be localized reliably in time.

recommendation.zh: 结论对视频 test-time scaling 有启发，但和文本 LLM 距离较远；只看 Fig 中 search space 对比和重启机制即可。
recommendation.en: Useful framing for inference-time search in video diffusion, but far from text LLM pretraining; focus on the search-space comparison and restart mechanism figures.

paper.title: World Model Self-Distillation: Training World Models to Solve General Tasks
paper.abstract: Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability

summary.core_problem: 解决预训练视频生成世界模型依赖详细文本描述无法直接用于规划决策、监督微调数据成本高难以扩展的问题
summary.importance: 范式创新+方法创新，提出无需人工标注任务视频的可扩展框架，将视频扩散模型的生成能力转化为通用任务解决能力
summary.technical_approach: 提出自蒸馏结合强化学习的框架：1）用视觉-语言模型为无标注场景图像生成候选任务与分步解决方案；2）用解决方案条件预训练视频扩散模型（Demonstrator）生成执行视频；3）将Demonstrator的行为蒸馏到仅依赖图像和短任务提示的Executor模型，实现指令条件的任务求解
summary.experiments: 摘要截断未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与基线对比数值，核心贡献为可扩展的训练框架设计

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two limitations of pretrained video generator world models: reliance on detailed textual descriptions which blocks direct use for planning, and high cost of supervised fine-tuning data that is hard to scale
summary_en.importance: Paradigm + methodological innovation: proposes a scalable annotation-free framework to transfer generation capability of video diffusion models into general task-solving ability
summary_en.technical_approach: A self-distillation + reinforcement learning framework: 1) A VLM generates candidate tasks and step-by-step solutions for unlabeled scene images; 2) The solutions condition a pretrained video diffusion model (Demonstrator) to produce execution videos; 3) Distill Demonstrator's behavior into an Executor that only takes image and short task prompt for instruction-conditioned task solving
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated, no specific parameter scale, training data size or baseline comparison numbers provided; core contribution is the scalable training framework design

recommendation.zh: 视频世界模型的弱监督蒸馏思路可参考，仅看方法部分的框架设计即可，无直接可复用的LLM预训练结论
recommendation.en: Weakly-supervised distillation idea for video world models is worth referencing, only read the framework design in method section, no directly reusable conclusions for LLM pretraining

paper.title: Making Time Editable in Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern Diffusion Transformers for video generation provide limited control over the progression of time and the editing of temporal dynamics. We propose a temporal-control methodology that extends a pretrained DiT with explicit time editing, allowing control over motion speed and temporal structure without redesigning the backbone. Its core implementation augments the pretrained model with a lightweight temporal module, preserving the original generative prior while expanding its controllable dy

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 Diffusion Transformer 对时间进程和运动速度缺少可编辑控制的问题。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成控制方法，不是基座预训练论文；但对“在不破坏原生成先验的前提下做轻量可控扩展”这一设计思路有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在预训练视频 DiT 上外挂一个轻量 temporal module，实现显式时间编辑，可控制运动速度和时间结构，同时保持主干不重设计、尽量保留原有生成先验。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法可在不改 backbone 的情况下扩展时间控制能力，但未给出模型规模、训练数据、基线和量化提升细节。更像 controllability 工程改造，而非新的生成范式。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of editable control over temporal progression and motion speed in video Diffusion Transformers.
summary_en.importance: This is a video-generation controllability paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining work, but the idea of adding lightweight control without destroying the pretrained prior is mildly relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method augments a pretrained video DiT with a lightweight temporal module for explicit time editing, enabling control over motion speed and temporal structure while keeping the backbone unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved temporal controllability without redesigning the backbone, but does not provide model scale, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. It looks more like a controllability retrofit than a new generative paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练关系不大，但“外挂小模块保留原先验”这个 recipe 可借鉴；只看方法图和消融，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to LLM pretraining, but the add-on-module-without-breaking-the-prior recipe is worth a quick look; method figure plus ablations should be enough.

paper.title: TIDE: Task-Isolated Diffusion for Unified Video Editing and Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers have driven rapid progress in video generation and editing, yet these capabilities are still handled by separate, task-specific models. Building a unified framework that supports diverse video tasks remains an open challenge: existing unified attempts either require dedicated auxiliary encoders or lack explicit mechanisms to distinguish heterogeneous conditioning tokens, struggling when the number and type of visual conditions vary across tasks. We propo

summary.core_problem: 在一个统一视频扩散框架中同时支持指令编辑、参考编辑和多参考生成，并处理不同任务条件 token 的混杂问题。
summary.importance: 这是视频生成/编辑统一建模工作。对纯 LLM 预训练帮助有限，但对跨模态统一建模、条件 token 设计和任务隔离机制有一些可迁移的启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TIDE，在 Diffusion Transformer 中引入 per-token task embeddings，为 target/source/reference token 显式打上任务身份；再用 dual-path conditioning，同时结合视觉语言模型提供的高层语义与细粒度结构条件，以兼顾语义一致性和结构保真。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度；实验应覆盖统一视频编辑与生成多任务设定，并与任务专用模型或既有统一框架比较质量和泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks to unify instruction-based editing, reference-guided editing, and multi-reference generation within one video diffusion framework while handling heterogeneous conditioning tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation/editing paper. Its direct value for LLM pretraining is limited, but it offers some transferable ideas for cross-modal unified modeling, conditional token design, and task isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TIDE introduces per-token task embeddings in a Diffusion Transformer so each target/source/reference token carries an explicit task identity. It also uses a dual-path conditioning scheme that combines high-level semantics from a vision-language model with fine-grained structural guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or exact gains. The evaluation likely covers unified video editing and generation across multiple tasks against task-specific baselines and prior unified frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心，但“按 token 显式标注任务身份”这个设计值得记一下；若你做 AR+diffusion 统一建模，可只看条件编码部分。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining work, but the explicit per-token task identity is worth noting; if you work on AR+diffusion unified modeling, just read the conditioning design.

paper.title: Physics in 2-Steps: Locking Motion Priors Before Visual Refinement Erases Them
paper.abstract: Image-to-Video diffusion models leverage input images to generate visually stunning content, yet frequently produce motion that violates physical laws. We reveal a surprising finding: a 2-step generation often exhibits better physical consistency than a 50-step output from the same model. Through spectral analysis, we trace this to phase erosion during denoising; the phase degrades significantly (dropping by $\approx 18\%$ from step 2 to step 50), whereas the magnitude remains relatively stable.

summary.core_problem: 研究图像到视频扩散模型在长步数去噪中为何会生成视觉质量高但物理运动不一致的视频。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是生成模型推理动态分析和训练-free修正方法。它指出少步推理中保留的运动先验会在后续视觉细化中被削弱，对理解扩散视频模型的去噪轨迹有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文通过频谱分析区分相位和幅度信息，发现从第2步到第50步相位显著退化而幅度较稳定。基于此提出 PhaseLock：先从2步推理中提取运动先验，再用 Latent Delta Guidance 在完整去噪轨迹中约束高保真生成，避免后期细化抹掉早期运动结构。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕图像到视频扩散模型展开，比较2步与50步输出的物理一致性，并报告相位约下降约18%。PhaseLock 在多种运动场景中平均提升物理一致性约6.2分；摘要未给出完整模型规模、数据集细节和全部基线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why image-to-video diffusion models can improve visual fidelity with more denoising steps while degrading physical motion consistency.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an analysis of diffusion inference dynamics plus a training-free correction method. The useful signal is the claim that early-step motion priors can be erased by later visual refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors perform spectral analysis and separate phase from magnitude, finding that phase decays substantially from step 2 to step 50 while magnitude stays relatively stable. PhaseLock extracts a motion prior from a two-step trajectory and enforces it during full-step denoising through Latent Delta Guidance.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments compare two-step and fifty-step image-to-video generations on physical consistency. The abstract reports around an 18% phase drop and an average 6.2-point gain in physical consistency with PhaseLock; model scale, dataset details, and full baselines are not available from the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看相位退化分析即可；对视频扩散推理动态有旁证价值，但离LLM预训练方法论较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the phase-erosion analysis; it is a useful diffusion-dynamics clue, but far from LLM pretraining methodology.

paper.title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
paper.abstract: Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. We study this question by probing video diffusion models along latent trajectories corresponding to real videos with known physical plausibility. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the determinist

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很具体：视频扩散模型在生成结果里经常表现出物理错误，但它的内部表征里到底有没有形成可读出的物理知识。难点不在于做一个新的物理 benchmark，而在于如何把“真实视频”送进一个生成式 diffusion/flow 模型的内部轨迹里，因为这类模型通常只暴露从噪声到样本的前向采样过程，不直接提供给定真实视频对应的中间状态。作者解决的是这个可探测性问题：近似反演 deterministic sampling 轨迹，从 clean latent 沿 learned velocity field 反向积分回噪声，恢复一条与真实视频对应的 latent trajectory，再在这条轨迹上分析 transformer block 的隐藏状态、attention 和可解码物理信号。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义，不在视频生成效果本身，而在两个更基础的判断。第一，生成目标即使不是显式的预测式表征学习目标，内部也可能自发形成与物理一致性相关的结构化表示；这对理解 diffusion/flow 类语言建模或多模态生成模型的“内部知道什么”很有参考价值。第二，输出失败不等于内部没有知识，错误可能出在采样轨迹、解码阶段、或局部计算没有把已有信号稳定转化为最终样本。这一点对新型 LM 范式很重要，因为它提醒人们不要只用最终 generation quality 判断模型是否学到某种结构。若把视角放到统一生成模型、world model、甚至 diffusion LM，这篇工作的价值主要在 probing 方法和表示-行为脱钩这个结论，而不是某个具体物理任务分数。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三层。第一层是轨迹恢复。模型采用 flow-matching/ODE 形式的生成过程，作者从真实视频的 VAE latent 出发，沿 learned velocity field 反向积分，近似得到从 data point 回到 noise 的路径。这样每个时间步都能重新跑一遍 backbone，拿到 block-level hidden states 和 attention。作者在附录里讨论了这个近似反演的误差来源与上界，核心前提是 learned dynamics 在局部足够平滑，数值积分误差可控，因此恢复出的中间表示可以作为“模型若把该视频视作自己轨迹的一部分时会如何表示它”的近似。第二层是线性 probing。作者在不同 denoising time、不同 transformer depth 上训练线性 probe，预测视频是否物理 plausible，以及一些定量物理变量。重点不是用大 probe 榨性能，而是看物理信号在何处、何时出现。结果显示，中间层比输入 latent 或最终层更容易线性解码出物理信息，说明信号是在 denoising computation 中逐步形成的。第三层是因果干预。作者做了 block-level noise intervention，把某些层的表示替换、扰动或注入噪声，并定义 probe-surprise 一类指标，观察物理信号在网络中的敏感位置，以及轨迹是否越贴近模型自身连续动力学，物理信号越强。这个设计比纯 probing 多走了一步：它不只问“能不能读出来”，还问“哪些计算部件在承载或放大这个信号”。与 V-JEPA 这类预测式表征学习不同，这里没有显式 future prediction objective；与常见 diffusion interpretability 不同，这里不是分析随机生成样本，而是把真实视频嵌回模型轨迹中研究内部状态。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验主线不是追求大而全 benchmark，而是围绕几个核心现象做验证。第一，作者在具有已知物理可行性标签的真实视频上恢复轨迹，发现物理 plausibility 可以从 diffusion transformer 的中间表示中被线性解码，而且这种可解码性沿深度和时间并不均匀，通常在中间 block、特定噪声区间最强。第二，除了二分类的 plausible/implausible，文中还报告了部分定量物理变量也可被解码，说明模型内部不是只学到一个粗糙的“看起来像不像”信号，而是包含更细的动力学信息。第三，作者比较了不同轨迹条件下的信号强弱，结论是当恢复轨迹更贴近模型 learned continuous dynamics 时，probe 表现更好，支持“物理信息是 denoising dynamics 的副产物”这一解释。第四，干预实验显示，扰动某些 block 会显著削弱物理可解码性或改变生成行为，说明这些层不是被动携带相关性，而更可能参与了物理结构的形成与传递。就你关心的预训练视角，这些实验最值得看的不是绝对数值，而是三种曲线：probe accuracy 随层深变化、随 diffusion time 变化、以及干预前后变化。提供的页面里没有完整表格数字、模型参数量和数据规模细节；从正文语境看，研究对象是现代视频 diffusion transformer，配合 pretrained VAE latent 空间，而不是小型玩具模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者真正解决的是“如何在真实视频上恢复 diffusion 内部轨迹”，不是单纯做物理分类。然后看 Method 里 reverse sampling 的定义，重点理解为什么从 clean latent 反向积分可以近似得到可分析轨迹，以及这个近似在哪些条件下可信。接着看 probing 结果图，优先关注不同 block 和不同 time step 的可解码性分布，这决定了“物理信号何时形成”。如果时间有限，干预实验至少看一遍，因为它决定这篇工作是否只是相关性分析。附录里关于 approximation error 的讨论也值得看，尤其如果你关心把类似方法迁移到 diffusion LM、音频生成或 unified multimodal generator。预计 30-45 分钟可以抓住主结论；若要深挖，建议把 reverse ODE reconstruction 与 representation probing 的接口细读一遍，思考它是否能用于分析 AR 之外的新型生成范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharp question: when video diffusion models produce physically wrong videos, do they still encode physically meaningful structure internally? The main obstacle is access. Diffusion or flow-based generators expose trajectories from noise to data, but they do not naturally provide the intermediate states associated with a given real video. The paper tackles this observability problem by approximately inverting the deterministic sampling dynamics: starting from a clean video latent, it integrates the learned velocity field backward toward noise, reconstructing an approximate latent trajectory for a real video. This makes it possible to inspect hidden states and attention maps along the model’s own denoising path.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about video generation quality and more about representation formation in non-AR generative models. The central result is that a model can contain decodable physical knowledge even when its final outputs fail to respect that knowledge. That matters for diffusion LM, multimodal generators, and world-model style pretraining, because it separates internal competence from sampled behavior. It also suggests that denoising computation itself can induce structured latent representations, even without an explicit predictive objective such as future-state prediction. For pretraining researchers, the paper is useful as a probing methodology and as evidence that generation objectives may learn richer internal structure than output-only evaluation reveals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, trajectory reconstruction. The model is treated as a flow-matching or ODE-based generator with a learned velocity field. Given a real video encoded into the pretrained VAE latent space, the authors integrate the velocity field backward from the clean latent toward noise, producing an approximate reverse trajectory. This allows them to rerun the backbone at each time step and collect block-level hidden states and attention patterns. The appendix discusses approximation error and the conditions under which the recovered trajectory is a faithful proxy. Second, linear probing. They train lightweight probes on intermediate transformer states to predict physical plausibility and some quantitative physical variables. The point is not to maximize probe capacity, but to localize where and when physical information becomes linearly accessible. Third, causal intervention. They perform block-level noise interventions and use a probe-surprise style analysis to identify which components carry or amplify the physical signal. This goes beyond standard probing: it asks not only whether the information is readable, but also whether perturbing specific computations changes the signal and downstream generation. Compared with predictive representation learners such as V-JEPA, the model here is not trained with an explicit future-prediction objective. Compared with standard diffusion interpretability work, the analysis is anchored on real videos embedded back into the model’s trajectory rather than on arbitrary generated samples.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around a few core phenomena rather than a broad benchmark sweep. First, on real videos with known physical plausibility labels, the recovered trajectories show that physical plausibility is linearly decodable from intermediate diffusion-transformer states. The signal is not uniform across the network: it tends to peak at certain depths and noise levels, often in intermediate blocks rather than at the input latent or final layer. Second, the paper reports that some quantitative physical variables are also decodable, which suggests the model is not merely storing a coarse plausible-versus-implausible cue. Third, the strength of the signal depends on trajectory fidelity: when the reconstructed path better follows the model’s learned continuous dynamics, probe performance improves, supporting the claim that physical structure emerges from denoising dynamics. Fourth, intervention experiments show that perturbing specific blocks weakens decodability or changes generation behavior, indicating that these layers are involved in forming and transmitting the signal rather than passively correlating with it. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, model sizes, or training-scale details, but the study is clearly conducted on modern video diffusion transformers operating in a pretrained VAE latent space rather than on toy models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the first method figure. The key contribution is not a new physics benchmark, but a way to recover internal diffusion trajectories for real videos. Then read the reverse-sampling section carefully: the main technical question is why backward integration from a clean latent is a reasonable approximation and what its failure modes are. After that, focus on the probing plots across transformer depth and diffusion time. Those figures tell you where the physical signal emerges. If time is limited, still read the intervention section, because it determines whether the paper is only about correlation or says something causal about computation. The appendix on approximation error is worth reading if you are interested in adapting the same idea to diffusion LM, audio generation, or unified multimodal generators. A quick but useful read is about 30 to 45 minutes; a deeper read should center on the interface between reverse ODE reconstruction and representation probing.

recommendation.zh: 把扩散当world model的人该看：反向积分拿到中间态再做线性探针很“干净”，但别被81%冲昏头，先核对反演误差与对照实验是否严谨。
recommendation.en: If you treat diffusion as a world model, read this: backward integration + linear probes is a clean diagnostic, but verify inversion error controls and baselines before trusting the 81% headline.

paper.title: LVSA: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Dense self-attention is the compute and quality bottleneck of long-video diffusion inference: cost grows quadratically with the sequence length, and beyond the training horizon the model converges to near-static output, that is, "frozen" repetitive video. State of the art approaches are either too costly, e.g., they require retraining, or fail to satisfy both performance and quality objectives in a scalable manner. To this end, we introduce Long Video Sparse Attention (LVSA), a training-free mod

summary.core_problem: 长视频 diffusion transformer 的 dense self-attention 在帧数增长时带来二次复杂度和显存压力，并且在超过训练 horizon 后容易生成近乎静止或循环的视频。LVSA 解决的是推理阶段如何在不重训模型的条件下，同时降低长视频 attention 成本并缓解 temporal repetition。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于推理侧稀疏注意力设计。它不直接改预训练目标，但对长上下文多模态模型有工程和建模启发：稀疏 pattern 不能只看 FLOPs，还要避免固定网格带来的长程伪影。对视频 DiT、长上下文 VLM、以及未来统一生成模型，训练外 attention pattern 是否能稳定外推到更长 horizon，是一个实际问题。
summary.technical_approach: LVSA 是 training-free、model-agnostic 的 block-sparse attention。对每个 query frame，它不再 attend 到所有 T 个时间帧，而是 attend 到局部窗口和全局锚点的并集：局部窗口 W(t) 覆盖当前帧附近的 temporal neighborhood，用来保持短期运动连续性；全局帧集合 G 按周期选取关键时间点，用来提供长程参照。摘要还强调 rotating global anchors 和 expanded adaptive window logic，目的是减少固定稀疏网格的偏置，避免某些时间位置长期缺少全局连接。实现上结合 FlashInfer kernel，把稀疏 frame selection 转成高效 block-sparse attention。它和 RIFLEx、UltraViCo 的差别是：RIFLEx 主要改 temporal RoPE 外推，UltraViCo 依赖 pairwise logit decay；LVSA 直接改推理 attention 的可见集合，并且不需要重新训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Wan 2.1 1.3B、Wan 2.1 14B、HunyuanVideo 1.5 等不同视频 DiT。最长测试 horizon 下，LVSA+FlashInfer 在 Wan 2.1 1.3B 上达到 3.17× 加速，在 Wan 2.1 14B 上达到 2.98×，在 HunyuanVideo 1.5 上达到 3.33×。在 Wan 系列 6× horizon 上，LVSA 在自建 VQeval 上明显优于 dense attention，主要因为 VQeval 更能惩罚 frozen 或 loopy video。它还让 HunyuanVideo 1.5 在 2× horizon、257 frames 下完成生成，而 dense attention 因显存不足不可行。与 UltraViCo 和 RIFLEx 相比，报告中最高有 3.27× 的计算优势，同时质量指标更好。NPU 实验中，Wan 2.2 A14B 为 2.71× 加速，Wan 2.1 1.3B 为 3.24× 加速。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 attention pattern 的定义、rotating global anchors 的具体实现、VQeval 如何识别循环和冻结失败，以及不同 backbone 上的速度-质量曲线。对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是 kernel 细节，而是稀疏连接模式为什么会影响长程生成质量：局部窗口保运动，全局锚点保长程参照，旋转机制减少固定 pattern 的系统性偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense self-attention in video diffusion transformers scales quadratically with the number of frames and becomes a memory bottleneck for long generation. Beyond the training horizon, it can also produce frozen or repetitive videos. LVSA targets inference-time long-video generation without retraining: reduce attention cost while avoiding long-range temporal artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient inference and sparse attention design. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it is informative for long-context multimodal modeling: sparse patterns should be evaluated not only by FLOPs, but also by the temporal biases they introduce. For video DiTs, long-context VLMs, and unified generative models, training-free attention extrapolation is a practical design axis.
summary_en.technical_approach: LVSA is a training-free, model-agnostic block-sparse attention algorithm. For each query frame, attention is restricted to the union of a local temporal window and a set of global anchor frames. The local window preserves short-term motion continuity, while periodically selected global frames provide long-range references. The abstract further highlights rotating global anchors and expanded adaptive window logic, which are intended to reduce fixed-grid bias and avoid systematic temporal artifacts. The method is implemented with a FlashInfer kernel to make the block-sparse pattern efficient. Compared with RIFLEx, which modifies temporal RoPE extrapolation, and UltraViCo, which applies pairwise logit decay, LVSA directly changes the visible frame set during inference and requires no finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers several video diffusion transformers, including Wan 2.1 1.3B, Wan 2.1 14B, and HunyuanVideo 1.5. At the longest tested horizon, LVSA with FlashInfer reports 3.17× speedup on Wan 2.1 1.3B, 2.98× on Wan 2.1 14B, and 3.33× on HunyuanVideo 1.5. On the Wan models at a 6× horizon, LVSA scores clearly above dense attention on the proposed VQeval benchmark, which is designed to penalize frozen and loopy outputs more directly than standard long-video metrics. It also enables HunyuanVideo 1.5 generation at a 2× horizon of 257 frames, where dense attention runs out of memory. Against UltraViCo and RIFLEx, the paper reports up to 3.27× compute advantage with better quality scores. NPU results show 2.71× speedup on Wan 2.2 A14B and 3.24× on Wan 2.1 1.3B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20–30 minutes. Read the definition of the sparse attention pattern, the implementation of rotating global anchors, the VQeval design for detecting looping and freezing, and the speed-quality curves across backbones. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is why sparse connectivity affects long-horizon generation quality: local windows preserve motion, global anchors preserve long-range reference, and rotation reduces systematic bias from a fixed pattern.

recommendation.zh: 看 sparse pattern 和 kernel 部分即可；若质量指标干净，它对长上下文生成注意力设计有可复用信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the sparse pattern and kernel sections; if the quality metrics are clean, it provides reusable signal for long-context generative attention design.

paper.title: VideoMLA: Low-Rank Latent KV Cache for Minute-Scale Autoregressive Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Long-rollout causal video diffusion has converged on a fixed-size sliding-window KV cache, with recent progress innovating within this layout by changing which tokens occupy the window or how their positions are encoded. The per-head KV layout itself, a dominant contributor to streaming memory and latency, has been mostly left unchanged. In this paper, we present the first study of Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) in video diffusion. VideoMLA replaces per-head keys and values with a shared low-

summary.core_problem: 降低分钟级自回归视频扩散中的 KV cache 显存和延迟，同时尽量保持长视频生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和机制分析。VideoMLA 将 Multi-Head Latent Attention 从语言模型迁移到视频扩散，并指出 MLA 在视频中有效并不依赖常见的低秩注意力谱假设，这对理解 MLA 的真实作用机制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用共享低秩 content latent 和共享的解耦 3D-RoPE positional key，替代逐 head 存储的 key/value。这样每个 cached layer 的 per-token KV memory 降低 92.7%。论文还分析预训练视频 attention 的有效秩，发现 99% energy effective rank 远高于实用 latent 维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在直接谱近似会预测失败的压缩比例下，VideoMLA 仍能保持视频质量。实验聚焦长 rollout causal video diffusion 的 KV cache 压缩、显存和延迟收益，以及压缩后质量保持。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 列表和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces KV-cache memory and latency for minute-scale autoregressive video diffusion while preserving long-video generation quality.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-efficiency and mechanism-analysis contribution. VideoMLA transfers Multi-Head Latent Attention from language models to video diffusion and argues that MLA can work even when the usual low-rank attention-spectrum assumption does not hold.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces per-head keys and values with a shared low-rank content latent and a shared decoupled 3D-RoPE positional key. This reduces per-token KV memory by 92.7% at every cached layer. The paper also analyzes the effective rank of pretrained video attention and finds that the 99%-energy rank is far above practical latent dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that VideoMLA preserves quality at compression ratios where direct spectral approximation would predict large degradation. Experiments focus on KV-cache compression, memory and latency benefits, and quality retention in long-rollout causal video diffusion. The abstract does not provide model scale, training data, baseline list, or full numbers.

recommendation.zh: 重点看“非低秩但 MLA 仍有效”的分析；这会修正把 MLA 只理解成谱压缩的朴素 prior。
recommendation.en: Focus on the “not low-rank yet MLA works” analysis; it corrects the simplistic view that MLA is just spectral compression.

paper.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Scaling Diffusion Transformers to generate high-resolution, long videos is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention, and existing sparse attention methods degrade under high sparsity. We show empirically that generation quality is determined not by the sparsity ratio itself, but by how well the sparse mask aligns with the tile-wise geometry of full attention. Based on this insight, we propose Veda, a distilled sparse attention framework that formulates tile selection as an explicit re

summary.core_problem: 解决高分辨率长视频 Diffusion Transformer 中自注意力二次复杂度过高、常规稀疏注意力在高稀疏率下质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和注意力系统优化，重点不在 LLM 预训练，但其“从 full attention 蒸馏稀疏 mask”的思路对长上下文注意力稀疏化和视频生成模型服务有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Veda 将 tile 选择建模为对 full attention 的显式重建问题，而不是手工设定稀疏模式；使用 statistics-aware tile scoring 降低估计误差，使用 head-aware tiling 减少不同 attention head 的结构错配，并配套 tile-skipping kernel 将稀疏性转成实际 wall-clock 加速。
summary.experiments: 在大型视频扩散模型 Waver 和 Wan2.1 上测试，目标包括 720P、10 秒视频生成；摘要称在无明显生成质量下降的情况下取得显著加速，但未给出具体稀疏率、延迟、吞吐或质量指标数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quadratic self-attention cost in high-resolution long-video diffusion transformers, where naive sparse attention tends to degrade quality at high sparsity.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency and attention-systems contribution. It is not LLM pretraining work, but the full-attention-distilled sparse-mask idea is relevant to long-context sparsification and large generative-model serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Veda formulates tile selection as an explicit reconstruction problem against full attention rather than relying on fixed sparse patterns. It combines statistics-aware tile scoring, head-aware tiling, and a hardware-oriented tile-skipping kernel to make sparsity translate into wall-clock speedups.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on large video diffusion models including Waver and Wan2.1, targeting settings such as 720P 10-second video generation. The abstract reports substantial acceleration without noticeable quality loss, but does not provide exact latency, sparsity, throughput, or quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看 tile 重建目标和 kernel 部分即可，判断它能否迁移到长上下文 LLM 稀疏注意力。
recommendation.en: Do not read end to end; inspect the tile-reconstruction objective and kernel section to judge transferability to sparse long-context LLM attention.

paper.title: SGMD: Score Gradient Matching Distillation for Few-Step Video Diffusion Distillation
paper.abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a widely used paradigm for accelerating inference in few-step video diffusion models. However, DMD-style video distillation faces two coupled challenges: the fake score must track a continuously evolving generator, making training costly when frequent updates are required, while reverse-KL-style matching can be mode-seeking and conservative for preserving strong motion dynamics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distil

summary.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation has two coupled issues: fake score must track evolving generator (high training cost), and reverse-KL matching is mode-seeking/conservative for motion dynamics.
summary.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD) as a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion models.
summary.technical_approach: Directly optimizes fake score toward teacher score, using teacher stop-gradient Fisher as stable distribution-matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary.experiments: Empirically outperforms DMD2. Authors from Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK, Beihang, with Dahua Lin (CUHK) on the author list.
summary.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

summary_en.core_problem: DMD-style video diffusion distillation suffers from costly tracking of evolving generator and conservative reverse-KL matching that suppresses motion dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD), a new distillation paradigm for few-step video diffusion acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct fake score optimization toward teacher via stop-gradient Fisher matching objective. Dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms DMD2 empirically. Author list includes Dahua Lin (CUHK).
summary_en.authors_note: Chinese Academy of Sciences, CUHK (Dahua Lin), Beihang University

recommendation.zh: 视频diffusion蒸馏方法，distillation机制对推理加速有参考价值，但核心应用域是视频生成，LLM研究员仅需知晓概念。
recommendation.en: Video diffusion distillation method. The distillation mechanism has some transfer value for inference acceleration but the domain is video generation — LLM researchers only need conceptual awareness.

paper.title: AdaState: Self-Evolving Anchors for Streaming Video Generation
