summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散在流式生成中被第一帧锚定，导致长程视频动态、视角变化和场景演进不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成机制改进。论文指出固定第一帧作为 KV cache 中的特权 anchor 会带来静态一致性与动态演化之间的取舍，这个观察对长序列生成和 cache 条件设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaState，用一个随每个 chunk 共同去噪但不渲染的隐藏 latent 替代固定第一帧 anchor。该 latent 作为自演化场景状态，每步由模型根据历史内容更新，用于提供当前场景参考，而不是长期引用初始帧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或数值结果。实验目标应是比较固定首帧 anchor 与 adaptive state 在运动幅度、camera movement、场景进展和时间一致性上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the first-frame anchoring problem in autoregressive streaming video diffusion, where long-rollout dynamics, viewpoint changes, and scene progression are suppressed.
summary_en.importance: It is a video generation mechanism improvement. The key observation is that a privileged first-frame representation in the KV cache creates a trade-off between static consistency and temporal evolution, which is relevant to long-sequence generation and cache-based conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaState replaces the fixed first-frame anchor with a hidden latent state that is denoised alongside each generated chunk but never rendered. This latent acts as a self-evolving scene reference updated from history, rather than a frozen reference to the initial frame.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scale, training data, baselines, or numerical results. The expected comparisons are between fixed first-frame anchoring and adaptive state conditioning on motion, camera movement, scene progression, and temporal consistency.

recommendation.zh: 只需看 anchor 失效分析；方法偏视频生成，但“干净早期 token 吸走注意力”像长上下文里的 sink 问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the anchor failure analysis; the method is video-specific, but the clean early-token attention sink resembles long-context pathologies.

paper.title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contributi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion 里的 KV-cache 低比特量化失真问题。核心观察是，INT2 量化后的质量下降不只是普通量化噪声，而是 softmax 注意力中出现了系统性偏置：被量化的历史 key 会获得过多注意力，挤压当前未量化 chunk 的注意力质量。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不高，但对长上下文生成模型和多模态 diffusion transformer 的推理系统有参考价值。它把 KV-cache 量化误差从“数值近似问题”细化到“softmax 分布偏移问题”，这对 LLM/VLM 的 KV 量化也有启发：key 的误差不只影响 score 的均方误差，还会通过指数函数改变 partition function，从而系统性改变注意力分配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是 Jensen bias correction。量化 key 时，key 误差近似为零均值，因此 pre-softmax score 在期望上可以保持无偏。但 softmax 使用 exp，指数函数是凸函数，零均值 score noise 经过 exp 后会带来正向膨胀：E[exp(s+η)] 大于 exp(s)。历史 cached token 的 key 被量化，而当前 chunk 的 key 没有被量化，于是 cached token 的 softmax 分母贡献被系统性放大。论文根据量化 step size 在线估计每个 attention score 的噪声方差，并在 cached-key score 上减去一个校正项。二阶 Taylor 近似下，校正项接近 score noise 方差的一半；方差由 query 各通道幅度和 key 量化步长共同决定。方法不需要重新训练，不修改 value cache，也可以和 Hadamard rotation、per-token 或 group-wise quantization 结合。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是定位和修正 INT2/INT4 KV-cache 量化的注意力偏置。论文报告 INT4 KV-cache 量化通常还能维持可接受质量，INT2 会出现明显帧失真。注意力诊断显示，量化后 attention mass 会稳定偏向 cached tokens，这一现象跨 layer、head、denoising step 和 prompt 都存在，并且和视频质量下降相关。加入 Jensen bias correction 后，注意力分配更接近未量化模型，并在多个视频 diffusion 模型和量化配置上改善最终视频质量。提供的内容没有完整实验表，无法可靠给出具体 benchmark 数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的失真现象定义，Preliminaries 中的量化设定和 Hadamard rotation，Section 4 附近关于 Jensen bias 的推导，以及 Fig. 1–3 的 attention mass 诊断。若关心 LLM KV-cache 量化，可重点检查校正项是否依赖视频 diffusion 的 chunk 结构；如果公式只依赖 query 和 key quantization step size，它有机会迁移到文本和多模态长上下文 serving。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why low-bit KV-cache quantization hurts chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion. The main issue is not just random quantization error. Quantized cached keys systematically attract too much attention mass, stealing probability from the current, unquantized chunk.
summary_en.importance: The work is only indirectly related to LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context generative serving and multimodal transformer systems. Its main value is a sharper diagnosis of KV-cache quantization: key noise changes the softmax partition function through the exponential, so preserving unbiased pre-softmax scores is not enough. This is a relevant lesson for KV compression in LLMs and VLMs as well.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed fix targets what the authors call Jensen bias. Quantizing cached keys introduces approximately zero-mean perturbations to attention scores. Because softmax applies an exponential, positive score perturbations are amplified more than negative perturbations are suppressed, so E[exp(s+η)] exceeds exp(s). Since only past cached keys are quantized while current-chunk keys remain full precision, the bias selectively inflates the cached-token contribution. The method estimates a per-score correction from the quantization step sizes available at inference time and subtracts it from cached-key attention logits before softmax. A second-order Taylor approximation gives a practical correction close to half of the score-noise variance. The procedure is training-free, leaves cached values unchanged, and is compatible with Hadamard rotation and token/group-wise quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is built around attention diagnostics and end-to-end video quality. INT4 KV-cache quantization remains usable in the reported setting, while INT2 causes severe visual artifacts. The authors show a consistent shift of attention mass toward cached tokens across layers, heads, denoising steps, and prompts, and this shift correlates with poor video quality. Applying the correction brings the attention distribution closer to the unquantized model and improves video-generation benchmarks across multiple models and quantization schemes. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact metric values should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode, the quantization preliminaries for the cache setup, the Jensen-bias derivation for the core idea, and Figures 1–3 for the diagnostic evidence. For LLM KV-cache work, the main question to check is whether the correction depends on video-specific chunking or only on query magnitudes and key quantization scales; the latter would make the idea easier to port to text and multimodal long-context inference.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Jensen bias 推导和量化消融；若 LLM KV 量化还默认零均值噪声无偏，这篇会改 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the Jensen-bias derivation and quantization ablations; it challenges the lazy prior that zero-mean KV noise is harmless under softmax.

paper.title: Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation
paper.abstract: We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.   In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a mono

summary.core_problem: 探索视频 diffusion 模型能否在去中心化计算环境中完成预训练，并保持时间一致性和生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练系统和生成模型训练 recipe。它的直接对象是视频生成，但对缺少单一大集群时的大规模预训练组织方式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Paris 2.0 继承 Paris 1.0 的 Decentralized Diffusion Model 训练思路，将文本到视频 diffusion 训练拆到去中心化计算资源上完成。摘要未说明具体同步协议、梯度聚合、容错或数据切分机制。
summary.experiments: 在低分辨率 text-to-video 训练中，与使用相同数据和匹配总计算量的单体训练模型相比，Paris 2.0 将 FVD 从 561.04 降至 279.01，约 2.0 倍改善，并提升 CLIP text-video similarity 与 aesthetic score。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和训练时长。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a video diffusion model can be pretrained with decentralized compute while preserving temporal coherence and generation quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-system recipe for generative video models. Although it is not an LLM paper, it is relevant as a signal on how large generative pretraining might be organized without a monolithic GPU cluster.
summary_en.technical_approach: Paris 2.0 extends the decentralized diffusion training recipe from Paris 1.0 to text-to-video generation. The abstract does not specify the synchronization protocol, aggregation method, fault tolerance mechanism, or data-sharding details.
summary_en.experiments: In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 reduces FVD from 561.04 to 279.01 and improves CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score. Model size, data scale, and training duration are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 看实验设置是否真公平即可；若同步和数据切分没讲清，FVD提升只能当去中心化训练弱信号。
recommendation.en: Check whether the compute and data setup is truly fair; without synchronization and sharding details, the FVD gain is only weak evidence.

paper.title: E$^3$C: Video Generation with 3D Environmental Memory and Ego-Exo Human Pose Control
paper.abstract: Controllable and physically grounded egocentric video generation is essential for embodied agents to reason about how their own and others' actions manifest and change the world. Compared to generic video synthesis, egocentric generation is especially challenging: the camera is tightly coupled to the actor, leading to rapid viewpoint changes and frequent self-occlusions; the underlying actions are subtle, articulated, and often only partially visible; and both the people and the scene state must

summary.core_problem: 解决第一视角视频生成中相机运动、人体动作、遮挡和场景状态需要长期一致控制的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成方法创新，面向 embodied agents 的可控世界模拟。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对多模态世界模型、视频 token/latent 条件设计和具身数据生成有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: E3C 使用视频扩散框架，把持久场景结构和人体驱动动态分开建模：从上下文帧构建半稠密点云形式的 3D environmental memory，并用 video-VAE 特征为点云附加外观描述；随后将该记忆渲染到目标视角，作为与目标帧对齐的条件，同时引入 ego-exo human pose control 来约束自我动作和他人动作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度；实验应围绕 egocentric controllable video generation 的时空一致性、控制遵循度和视觉质量展开。
summary.authors_note: Richard Newcombe 和 Julian Straub 是 Meta Reality Labs 相关的知名 3D/场景理解研究者；团队背景更偏 3D 感知、AR/VR 和具身视觉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses controllable egocentric video generation, where camera motion, human pose, occlusion, and persistent scene state must remain consistent.
summary_en.importance: This is a video generation method rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its relevance is indirect: the conditioning design is useful for thinking about multimodal world models and structured latent memory for embodied data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: E3C builds a structured conditioning interface for a video diffusion model. It extracts a semi-dense point-cloud 3D environmental memory from context frames, augments points with appearance descriptors from video-VAE features, renders the memory into target views, and combines it with ego-exo human pose control to separate persistent scene structure from action-driven dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training scale, baseline list, or numerical improvements. The likely evaluation focuses on egocentric generation quality, temporal consistency, and controllability under pose and viewpoint changes.
summary_en.authors_note: Richard Newcombe and Julian Straub are known for 3D vision and AR/VR work at Meta Reality Labs; the team is closer to embodied vision and scene reconstruction than to language-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 3D memory 条件设计即可；对统一视频 LM 不是直接答案，但能提醒别把场景状态全塞进隐变量。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and the 3D-memory conditioning; it is not a direct recipe for video LMs, but it is a useful reminder not to hide all scene state in latents.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频扩散 world model 的长期一致性与实时推理之间的冲突。完整 KV-cache attention 能在重访场景时保持内容一致，但显存和 attention 计算随 rollout 长度线性增长；滑动窗口能保持速度，却会丢掉早期场景记忆，导致重访时漂移或生成新内容。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于传统 LLM 预训练方法，但对自回归多模态生成模型和长期上下文推理有参考价值。它的关键观察是：KV cache 不只是加速缓存，也可以作为模型已有的隐式世界记忆。与训练外部 memory module 或显式 3D 表示相比，WorldKV 选择直接管理模型自身的 KV cache，因此更接近 serving-time memory policy。对 LLM 研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不一定只靠扩大上下文窗口，也可以通过检索、压缩、重插入已有 KV 来获得更低成本的历史访问。
summary.technical_approach: WorldKV 是 training-free 框架，由 World Retrieval 和 World Compression 两部分组成。World Retrieval 把滑动窗口中被驱逐的 KV-cache chunk 存到 GPU/CPU memory，在模型重访相关场景时再选择性取回，并直接插回原生 attention window，不需要重编码，也不改模型结构。检索策略是模块化的，可以使用 camera/action correspondence，也可以使用 attention-based retrieval。World Compression 针对相邻帧 KV 高度冗余的问题，用 Key-Key similarity 识别并裁剪重复 token，把每个 chunk 大约压到一半大小。这样在同样 memory budget 下能保留约 2 倍历史，同时避免完整历史 attention 的线性开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个不同规模的自回归视频 world model 上评估：Matrix-Game-2.0 和 LingBot-World-Fast。一个重要实验现象是，即使 Matrix-Game-2.0 训练时只用 6-frame sliding window，推理时放开完整 KV-cache 仍能利用过去 cache 重建曾经看过的视角，说明这种记忆并不完全依赖长序列训练。成本方面，论文指出每帧会产生约 880 到 1,560 个 token，一分钟 rollout 会累积到数十万 token；LingBot-World-Fast 使用完整历史时，FPS 从 8.87 降到 3.61。World Compression 能把 chunk 约减半，World Retrieval 则在不读取完整历史的情况下提升 revisit fidelity。论文称 training-free KV 管理在重访一致性上可匹配或超过 full KV-cache attention 和 memory-trained baselines，同时保持实时推理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解“KV cache 已经携带世界记忆”和“完整历史 attention 不可承受”这两个前提。方法部分重点看 World Retrieval 如何定义 chunk、如何根据相机/动作或 attention 取回历史 KV，以及 World Compression 的 Key-Key similarity pruning。实验部分关注 Matrix-Game-2.0 的短上下文训练但长记忆可用这一点，这比具体应用演示更有方法价值。Appendix C 如果有时间可以看，用来判断 retrieval 策略是否可迁移到其他自回归多模态模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tension between long-term consistency and real-time inference in autoregressive video diffusion world models. Full-history KV-cache attention can preserve scene consistency during revisits, but memory and attention cost grow with rollout length. Sliding-window inference keeps the system fast, but evicts the very caches needed to recover previously seen views.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as an inference-time memory management study for autoregressive multimodal generation. Its central observation is that KV cache is not only a compute buffer; it can act as an implicit world memory already available inside the model. Instead of training an external memory module, adding cross-attention, or reconstructing an explicit 3D scene, the method manages and reuses the model’s own KV cache. For LLM researchers, the useful analogy is long-context access under a bounded budget: selective retrieval and compression of past KV can be an alternative to simply increasing the active context window.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV is a training-free framework with two components. World Retrieval stores evicted KV-cache chunks in GPU or CPU memory and retrieves scene-relevant chunks when the camera or action trajectory indicates a revisit. The retrieved caches are inserted back into the native attention window, without re-encoding and without architectural changes. The retrieval interface is modular and can use camera/action correspondence or attention-based selection. World Compression reduces redundancy across adjacent video frames by pruning tokens according to Key-Key similarity. Since neighboring frames produce near-duplicate KV entries, compressing each chunk to roughly half size allows about twice as much history to be retained under the same memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast. A notable finding is that Matrix-Game-2.0, although trained with only a 6-frame sliding window, can still use full past KV caches at inference time to reconstruct previously visited viewpoints. This supports the claim that the memory effect is not limited to models trained on minute-long sequences. The cost motivation is concrete: each frame produces around 880 to 1,560 tokens, so a one-minute rollout can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens. On LingBot-World-Fast, full-history attention reduces FPS from 8.87 to 3.61 over a one-minute rollout. WorldKV uses retrieval to avoid attending to the full history and compression to roughly halve chunk size. The reported results show revisit fidelity comparable to or better than full KV-cache attention and memory-trained baselines while maintaining real-time inference.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 in the introduction: they establish the two core claims, namely that KV carries usable scene memory and that full-history attention is too expensive. Then read the method sections on World Retrieval and World Compression. The most transferable details are chunk construction, camera/action-based retrieval, attention-based retrieval, and Key-Key similarity pruning. The Matrix-Game-2.0 result is worth noting because it separates inference-time cache reuse from long-sequence training. Appendix C is useful if the goal is to judge whether the retrieval policy could be adapted to other autoregressive multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 KV 记忆的思路值得借鉴；重点看 retrieval key 的定义和压缩误差，别被视频场景绑住。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for long-context KV memory design; focus on the retrieval key and compression error, not the video-specific framing.

paper.title: Dynamic Video Generation: Shaping Video Generation Across Time and Space
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved impressive performance in video generation, but their iterative denoising process remains computationally expensive due to the large number of tokens processed at each timestep. Recently, progressive resolution sampling has emerged as a promising acceleration approach by reducing latent resolution in early stages. However, scaling this idea to video generation remains challenging, as the additional temporal dimension introduces diverse spatio-temporal demands acros

summary.core_problem: 降低视频扩散模型采样成本，尤其是每个 denoising step 都处理大量时空 token 带来的推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成推理加速。它不改变预训练目标，但动态分配时空计算的思想对大规模生成模型 serving 和 token 预算控制有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: DVG 将 progressive resolution sampling 扩展到视频场景，不只压缩单一空间维度，而是根据内容在时间和空间两维动态选择加速策略。方法强调无需手工调参、无需重训练，并可与其他加速方法组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 HunyuanVideo 和 HunyuanVideo-1.5 上实现近无损加速，最高 7 倍；与其他方法结合时最高 18 倍。摘要未给出具体 benchmark、质量指标或显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University、South China University of Technology、Tsinghua University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the sampling cost of video diffusion models, where each denoising step processes a large number of spatiotemporal tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for multimodal generation. It does not change pretraining objectives, but its dynamic spatiotemporal compute allocation is relevant to serving large generative models and managing token budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: DVG extends progressive resolution sampling to video by dynamically allocating computation across both time and space, rather than compressing only one dimension. It is content-aware, requires no manual tuning or retraining, and can be combined with other acceleration techniques.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims near-lossless acceleration on HunyuanVideo and HunyuanVideo-1.5, up to 7x speedup and up to 18x when combined with another method. Detailed benchmarks, metrics, and quality trade-offs are not available from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, South China University of Technology, and Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道但不必细读；看实验表确认质量指标，核心价值是生成模型推理预算的动态分配，不是预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing but not a full read; check the quality tables, since the useful signal is dynamic inference budgeting, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Q-ARVD: Quantizing Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models (ARVDs) have emerged as a promising architecture for streaming video generation, paving the way for real-time interactive video generation and world modeling. Despite their potential, the substantial inference cost of ARVDs remains a major obstacle to practical deployment, making model quantization a natural direction for improving efficiency. However, quantization for ARVDs remains largely unexplored. Our empirical analysis shows that directly applying exis

summary.core_problem: 研究自回归视频扩散模型在低比特量化时的退化问题，目标是在流式视频生成中降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率与量化行为分析。它不是 LLM 预训练工作，但 AR 生成链路中的误差累积和逐步敏感性，对理解长序列生成模型的压缩风险有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先实证分析标准 diffusion transformer 量化方法迁移到 ARVD 时的失效模式，指出自回归视频生成存在帧级量化敏感性严重不均衡的问题；摘要显示其核心观察是量化误差会沿自回归生成累积，导致不同帧对量化的容忍度呈指数式差异。具体 Q-ARVD 的完整校准、位宽分配或补偿策略需看正文确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 或提升数值。已知实验重点应是将现有 diffusion transformer 量化方案直接用于 ARVD 后的性能下降，并比较 Q-ARVD 对生成质量和推理效率的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore 和 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to quantize autoregressive video diffusion models while preserving generation quality for streaming video generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and quantization-behavior contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the error accumulation pattern in autoregressive generation is relevant to compression risks in long-sequence generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors empirically show that quantization methods designed for standard bidirectional diffusion transformers transfer poorly to ARVDs. The key observation in the abstract is highly unbalanced frame-wise sensitivity: quantization error accumulates through autoregressive generation and creates an exponential-like sensitivity decay across frames. The full paper is needed for the exact Q-ARVD calibration or bit-allocation mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected experimental setup compares direct application of existing diffusion-transformer quantization schemes against Q-ARVD on video quality and inference efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the National University of Singapore and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 只看量化敏感性分析即可；AR 生成里的误差累积是有用信号，方法本身离 LLM 预训练较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the sensitivity analysis; the AR error-accumulation signal is useful, but the method is far from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散世界模型在长时 rollout 中，KV-cache 线性增长导致无法同时保持实时性和世界一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率与长时记忆管理问题。虽然对象是视频世界模型，不是文本LLM，但其中的 cache 检索与压缩思路对长上下文推理、外部记忆和 KV 管理有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldKV，包含两部分：World Retrieval 将被驱逐的 KV chunk 存入 GPU/CPU，并根据相机/动作对应关系选择性取回插回原生 attention window；World Compression 则基于 key-key similarity 相对 anchor frame 剪除冗余 token，把每个 chunk 的存储压到约一半。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在 Matrix-Game-2.0 等环境上验证，目标是在固定预算下保留更长历史并维持世界一致性，同时满足实时约束；但这是视频扩散推理系统实验，不是语言模型标准长上下文基准。
summary.authors_note: 作者中 Sangdoo Yun 在高效模型与视觉生成方向有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the inability of autoregressive video diffusion world models to maintain both real-time throughput and persistent world consistency as KV-cache grows linearly with rollout length.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and long-horizon memory-management paper. The target is video world models rather than text LLMs, but the cache retrieval and compression ideas are transferable to long-context inference and external memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV has two parts: World Retrieval stores evicted KV chunks in GPU/CPU memory and selectively retrieves scene-relevant chunks using camera/action correspondence, while World Compression prunes redundant tokens within each chunk via key-key similarity to an anchor frame, roughly halving storage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on environments such as Matrix-Game-2.0, aiming to preserve longer history under a fixed memory budget while maintaining world consistency and real-time constraints. The setup is a video diffusion inference system rather than a standard language long-context benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Sangdoo Yun is a recognizable researcher in efficient models and vision generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本LLM，但‘驱逐后可检索KV’这个思路值得借到长上下文 serving；看 retrieval 条件和压缩准则就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a text LLM paper, but the retrievable-evicted-KV idea is worth borrowing for long-context serving; read the retrieval trigger and compression rule, then move on.

paper.title: Video Models Can Reason with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have made rapid progress in perceptual realism and temporal coherence, but they remain primarily optimized for plausible generation rather than verifiable reasoning. This limitation is especially pronounced in tasks where generated videos must satisfy explicit spatial, temporal, or logical constraints. Inspired by the role of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) in reasoning-oriented language models, we introduce VideoRLVR, a practical recipe for optimizin

summary.core_problem: 当前视频扩散模型主要优化感知真实度与时序一致性，训练目标仅追求生成合理性，而非可验证的逻辑/时空约束正确性。即使经过监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning，SFT），模型也可能模仿解法的视觉模式，却不满足任务底层的规则约束，导致视频推理能力难以稳定引出和验证。
summary.importance: 这是将大语言模型侧的可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards，RLVR）三阶段范式（预训练-监督微调-RLVR）迁移到生成式视频模型的系统性落地，证明生成式视觉模型也可以通过可验证奖励优化推理正确性，打破了此前视觉生成研究仅优先感知质量的路径依赖。提出的早期步聚焦、稠密分解奖励两个设计，解决了视频强化学习训练成本高、奖励稀疏的核心痛点，为多模态模型的对齐与推理优化提供了可复用的方法。该框架还将视频生成的范畴从内容合成拓展到视觉推理轨迹生成，定义了视频推理的新任务范式，对统一多模态推理的预训练-后训练闭环构建有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VideoRLVR是面向流匹配视频扩散模型优化的三组件框架。第一，采用SDE-GRPO优化主干，将扩散模型的逆去噪过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程（Markov Decision Process，MDP）的状态转移，把强化学习优化适配到扩散模型的连续去噪轨迹上，而非传统的离散token强化学习。第二，早期步聚焦（Early-Step Focus）策略将探索与反向传播仅集中在决定粗粒度结构和长程规划的早期去噪阶段，后期去噪步固定使用参考模型的输出，不做强化学习更新，大幅降低计算开销。第三，稠密分解奖励将稀疏的任务最终成功信号，拆解为每帧对应的可验证规则组件（如迷宫任务中每一步的移动合法性、向终点的推进程度、无回溯等）。基于规则的规划器生成真值轨迹来对齐帧序列与逻辑约束，即使任务全程失败也能提供有效反馈。完整训练管线对齐大语言模型的三阶段流程：预训练获得通用生成能力，在规则生成的解法轨迹上做监督微调，再通过VideoRLVR做强化学习优化。与此前依赖稀疏人工评分奖励、全去噪步优化的视频强化学习工作不同，该设计明确面向可验证的推理正确性，同时降低了训练开销。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖三个可验证推理任务：迷宫、FlowFree、推箱子。与用于初始化的监督微调检查点相比，VideoRLVR的任务成功率分别提升6.1%（迷宫）、5.5%（FlowFree）、3.2%（推箱子）。与持续监督微调相比，VideoRLVR在难度更高的任务上带来的提升幅度更大，说明可验证奖励能提供模仿学习无法覆盖的优化信号。在VBVR基准的分布外拆分上，VideoRLVR也表现出更优的跨域泛化能力。消融实验证实，稠密分解奖励对低成功率的难任务至关重要；早期步聚焦策略在保持性能几乎不变的前提下，减少约40%的训练时间。VideoRLVR在该可验证推理基准上的表现优于多个闭源与开源商用视频生成模型。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先关注第3章的问题形式化部分，理解如何将逆扩散去噪过程建模为MDP，这是强化学习适配视频扩散的核心基础。然后查看第4章三个核心组件的细节，特别是早期步聚焦策略中去噪阶段划分的依据，以及稠密奖励的具体拆解设计。实验部分重点关注表2的消融结果和VBVR跨域泛化结果，理解各组件的贡献和泛化性的来源。可深挖的方向包括：早期步优化的结论是否可迁移到文本扩散模型或自回归多模态模型的强化学习中，以及如何为无规则求解器的任务自动化设计可验证奖励。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video diffusion models are primarily optimized for perceptual realism and temporal coherence, with training objectives that only target generation plausibility rather than verifiable compliance with logical, spatial, or temporal constraints. Even after supervised fine-tuning (SFT), models may imitate the visual patterns of valid solutions without satisfying underlying task rules, making visual reasoning abilities difficult to reliably elicit and verify.
summary_en.importance: This systematic implementation of the LLM three-stage RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) paradigm (pretrain → SFT → RLVR) for generative video models proves that generative visual models can be optimized for reasoning correctness via verifiable rewards, breaking the prior path dependence of visual generation research that prioritizes only perceptual quality. The proposed Early-Step Focus and dense decomposed reward designs address the core pain points of high training cost and sparse rewards in video RL, providing reusable methods for alignment and reasoning optimization of multimodal models. This framework expands the scope of video generation from content synthesis to visual reasoning trajectory generation, defining a new task paradigm for video reasoning with direct reference value for building the pretrain-posttrain closed loop of unified multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoRLVR is a three-component framework optimized for flow-matching video diffusion models. First, it adopts an SDE-GRPO optimization backbone, which models the reverse denoising process of diffusion as state transitions in a Markov Decision Process (MDP), adapting RL optimization to the continuous denoising trajectory of diffusion models instead of traditional discrete-token RL. Second, the Early-Step Focus strategy concentrates exploration and backpropagation only on the early denoising phase where coarse-grained structure and long-range planning are determined; later denoising steps use fixed reference model outputs without RL updates, drastically reducing computational overhead. Third, dense decomposed rewards break the sparse end-of-task success signal into verifiable rule-based components aligned with each frame (e.g., valid movement, progress toward the goal, no backtracking in maze tasks). Rule-based planners generate ground-truth trajectories to align frame sequences with logical constraints, providing informative feedback even when full task success is rare. The full pipeline aligns with the LLM three-stage workflow: pretraining for general generative competence, SFT on rule-generated solution trajectories, then RL optimization via VideoRLVR. Unlike prior video RL work that relies on sparse human-scored rewards or full denoising step optimization, this design explicitly targets verifiable reasoning correctness while reducing training overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover three verifiable reasoning tasks: Maze, FlowFree, and Sokoban. Compared to the SFT checkpoint used for initialization, VideoRLVR improves task success rates by 6.1% (Maze), 5.5% (FlowFree), and 3.2% (Sokoban) respectively. Compared with continued SFT, VideoRLVR delivers larger gains on harder tasks, indicating verifiable rewards provide optimization signals not captured by imitation learning alone. It also shows improved out-of-domain transfer on the out-of-distribution split of the VBVR benchmark. Ablations confirm that dense decomposed rewards are critical for low-success-rate difficult tasks, and the Early-Step Focus strategy reduces training time by ~40% while retaining nearly identical performance. VideoRLVR outperforms multiple closed-source and open-source commercial video generation models on the verifiable reasoning benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, start with Section 3 on problem formulation to understand how the reverse diffusion denoising process is modeled as an MDP, the core foundation for adapting RL to video diffusion. Then review Section 4 for details of the three core components, especially the empirical justification for the denoising phase cutoff in Early-Step Focus, and the specific decomposition design of dense rewards. In experiments, focus on the ablation results in Table 2 and the VBVR out-of-domain generalization results to understand component contributions and generalization drivers. Follow-up exploration directions include verifying whether the early-step optimization conclusion transfers to text diffusion models or autoregressive multimodal model RL, and how to automate verifiable reward design for tasks without rule-based solvers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 SDE-GRPO 和早期去噪优化；它会改变“RLVR 只适合文本推理”的默认边界。
recommendation.en: Read the SDE-GRPO and early-denoising pieces; it weakens the prior that RLVR is mainly a text-reasoning recipe.

paper.title: ReactiveGWM: Steering NPC in Reactive Game World Models
paper.abstract: Current game world models simulate environments from a subjective, player-centric perspective. However, by treating the Non-Player Character (NPC) merely as background pixels, these models cannot capture interactions between the player and NPC. In that sense, they act as passive video renderers rather than real simulation engines, lacking the physical understanding needed to model action-induced NPC reactivities. We introduce ReactiveGWM, a reactive game world model that synthesizes dynamic inte

summary.core_problem: 现有游戏世界模型多从玩家视角生成视频，把 NPC 当作背景像素，难以建模玩家动作引发的 NPC 反应。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是交互式视频世界模型的方法改进。它把世界模型从被动渲染推进到带条件反应的生成模拟，但主要价值仍在游戏视频生成和可控生成，不直接推进 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: ReactiveGWM 显式拆分玩家控制和 NPC 行为：玩家动作通过轻量 additive bias 注入 diffusion backbone，高层 NPC 响应策略通过 cross-attention 模块接入。论文强调这些模块学习游戏无关的交互逻辑，从而支持零样本策略迁移。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在动态玩家-NPC 交互合成和零样本策略迁移上验证方法，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 benchmark 或数值提升。需要读正文确认 setup 是否覆盖不同游戏、不同 NPC 策略和长时序一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore、The Hong Kong Polytechnic University、HKUST Guangzhou、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、HKUST；未从给定信息确认知名基座模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Most game world models render player-centric videos and treat NPCs as background pixels, so they fail to model NPC reactions induced by player actions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level improvement for interactive video world models. It moves game generation from passive rendering toward conditional reactive simulation, but its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReactiveGWM separates player controls from NPC behavior. Player actions are injected into the diffusion backbone through a lightweight additive bias, while high-level NPC responses such as offense, control, and defense are grounded through cross-attention modules. The paper claims these modules learn game-agnostic interaction logic for zero-shot strategy transfer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on dynamic player-NPC interaction synthesis and zero-shot strategy transfer, but does not provide model size, training data scale, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The main thing to verify in the paper is whether the evaluation really stresses cross-game transfer and long-horizon consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, HKUST Guangzhou, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, and HKUST. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab background is available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可作为交互式世界模型备查；预训练侧只需看架构图，重点判断“解耦控制/反应”是否真能跨环境迁移。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference on interactive world models; for pretraining work, only inspect the architecture and whether control/reaction disentanglement truly transfers.

paper.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a s

summary.core_problem: 现有用于视频扩散模型对齐的GRPO方法计算成本极高，时间步下采样又会导致训练不稳定、性能下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出单步GRPO训练框架，大幅降低视频扩散对齐的计算成本，同时提升对齐性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flash-GRPO，用等时间分组消除时间步混淆的方差，用时间梯度矫正消除时间依赖的梯度缩放不一致问题，实现单步训练。
summary.experiments: 低计算预算下对齐质量超过全轨迹训练，14B参数模型训练效率大幅提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、清华大学、Joy Future Academy等。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GRPO for video diffusion alignment has extremely high computational cost, while timestep subsampling leads to training instability and performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a single-step GRPO training framework that drastically reduces computational cost for video diffusion alignment while improving alignment quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Flash-GRPO: use iso-temporal grouping to eliminate timestep-confounded variance, use temporal gradient rectification to neutralize time-dependent gradient scaling inconsistency, enabling single-step training.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms full-trajectory training in alignment quality under low compute budget, drastically improves training efficiency for 14B parameter models.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Zhejiang University, Tsinghua University, Joy Future Academy, etc.

recommendation.zh: GRPO单步训练和梯度矫正的思路可参考用于LLM对齐的效率优化，看方法部分摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The ideas of single-step GRPO training and gradient rectification can be referenced for LLM alignment efficiency optimization, only read method summary.

paper.title: HASTE: Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration via Head-Wise Adaptive Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based video generation has advanced substantially in visual fidelity and temporal coherence, but practical deployment remains limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Training-free sparse attention is attractive because it accelerates pretrained models without retraining, yet existing online top-$p$ sparse attention still spends non-negligible cost on mask prediction and applies shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity. We show that these two overlooked f

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散模型中的全注意力计算随序列长度二次增长，已有 training-free 稀疏注意力仍把不少开销花在 mask 预测上，并且忽略不同 attention head 的稀疏性差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它不改变预训练目标或模型架构，但对 DiT / 视频生成模型的注意力稀疏化有工程参考价值，尤其是如何在不重训的前提下做 head-wise 预算分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HASTE，一个 head-wise adaptive sparse attention 框架。核心包括 Temporal Mask Reuse，根据 query-key drift 判断是否复用前一步稀疏 mask，减少在线 mask 预测成本；以及 Error-guided Budgeted Calibration，在全局稀疏预算下按 head 分配 top-p 阈值，使输出误差最小。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Wan2.1-1.3B 和 Wan2.1-14B 视频生成模型上进行，与 training-free online top-p sparse attention 类方法比较。摘要称在 XAttn 加速和质量保持之间取得更稳定的折中，但提供文本中未给出具体加速倍数、质量指标和显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自厦门大学相关团队；给定信息中未能确认 Cohere 参与，按论文机构信息处理。

summary_en.core_problem: Full attention in video diffusion models has quadratic cost, while existing training-free sparse attention still spends nontrivial compute on mask prediction and uses shared thresholds despite strong head-level heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its useful part is the engineering treatment of sparse attention in Video DiTs, especially budget allocation across heads without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HASTE introduces a head-wise adaptive sparse attention framework. Temporal Mask Reuse skips mask prediction when query-key drift is small, and Error-guided Budgeted Calibration assigns per-head top-p thresholds by minimizing measured output error under a global sparsity budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Wan2.1-1.3B and Wan2.1-14B. The abstract reports consistent improvements in the XAttention speed-quality trade-off over training-free top-p sparse attention baselines, but the provided text does not include exact latency, quality, or ablation numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Xiamen University. The provided metadata mentions Cohere, but the author-institution information does not confirm Cohere involvement.

recommendation.zh: 只看 calibration 和 mask reuse 的 ablation；对 LLM 预训练没有直接动作，但 head-wise 稀疏预算值得做类比。
recommendation.en: Read only the calibration and mask-reuse ablations; it does not change LLM pretraining practice, but the head-wise sparsity budgeting is a useful analogy.

paper.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity
paper.abstract: While the overall inference latency of Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can be substantially reduced through model distillation, per-step inference latency remains a critical bottleneck. Existing acceleration paradigms primarily exploit redundancy across the denoising trajectory; however, we identify a limitation where these step-wise strategies encounter diminishing returns in few-step regimes. In such scenarios, the scarcity of temporal states prevents effective feature reuse or predictive

summary.core_problem: few-step 视频 DiT 在每一步推理延迟上仍然很高，现有沿去噪时间轴做加速的方法在低步数区间收益变差。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率而非预训练：提出一种 training-free 的视频扩散推理稀疏化框架，价值在于提醒大家 few-step regime 下优化目标应从 step 维转向 frame 维。
summary.technical_approach: FIS-DiT 利用 latent frame 维度中的双重结构：一方面存在帧级稀疏性，可减少计算；另一方面同一帧位置在不同 step 间具有结构一致性，可支持稳定的稀疏模式。方法不改模型参数、与算子无关，核心是 frame interleaved sparsity，在帧维上做交错稀疏计算以降低单步成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、视频分辨率、步数设定和加速比，但定位很清楚：针对 few-step 视频扩散推理，相比只利用 denoising trajectory 冗余的方案，试图进一步压低 per-step latency。

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step video DiTs still suffer from high per-step latency, and existing acceleration methods that exploit redundancy along the denoising trajectory become less effective in this regime.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining one: its main value is the shift in optimization target from the step dimension to the frame dimension for few-step video diffusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: FIS-DiT is a training-free, operator-agnostic framework that leverages a dual structure in the latent frame dimension: frame-wise sparsity for reduced computation and structural consistency across denoising steps for stable sparse patterns. The key idea is frame-interleaved sparsity to cut per-step cost without retraining.

recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that step-wise reuse saturates in few-step regimes is worth noting; read the motivation and speed tables, then move on.

paper.title: Diffusion-APO: Trajectory-Aware Direct Preference Alignment for Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Efficiently aligning large-scale video diffusion models with human intent requires a scalable and trajectory-aware pathway that bridges the inherent discrepancy between training noise distributions and practical inference trajectories. While existing paradigms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) attempt to address this, they are often hindered by either reliance on bias-prone, complex reward models or suboptimal timestep sampling. In this pa

summary.core_problem: 现有针对扩散模型的直接偏好优化（DPO）存在训练时间步采样与推理去噪轨迹不匹配的问题，导致梯度信号效率低；而依赖奖励模型的GRPO等方法受限于视频奖励模型不成熟、易引入偏差，缺乏适配视频扩散Transformer的轨迹感知偏好对齐方案。
summary.importance: 解决了扩散模型偏好对齐中训练-推理轨迹不匹配的通用问题，不仅适用于视频生成场景，也对文本扩散LLM的DPO对齐有参考价值；提出的多阶段模块化对齐框架可以为生成式大模型的全生命周期对齐提供可复用的流程设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Diffusion-APO算法，通过将训练时的噪声分布与推理时的去噪轨迹同步，解决传统扩散DPO的时间步采样错位问题，提升梯度信号效率；不需要显式标量奖励模型，避免了奖励模型带来的不稳定和偏差。在此基础上构建统一模块化框架，支持在线DPO（推理环反馈+预训练排序模型）、半在线DPO（平衡在线探索和离线缓存稳定性）、离线DPO（最终阶段精调）、感知蒸馏的DPO（缓解推理加速带来的对齐漂移）四个阶段，所有阶段共用一致的Diffusion-APO目标，保证理论一致性。
summary.experiments: 实验显示Diffusion-APO在生成保真度和指令遵循能力上持续优于标准DPO，同时可以同时优化基线模型和加速版本，在不同部署场景下都能保持高质量生成。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看引言部分对现有扩散DPO核心缺陷的分析，方法部分的轨迹对齐核心逻辑，以及多阶段对齐框架的设计思路，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing direct preference optimization (DPO) for diffusion models suffers from timestep sampling misalignment between training noise schedules and inference denoising trajectories, leading to low gradient signal efficacy. Meanwhile, reward-model-based methods like GRPO are limited by the immaturity of video reward models and are prone to introducing biases, with no mature trajectory-aware preference alignment solution tailored for video diffusion transformers.
summary_en.importance: It addresses the common train-inference trajectory misalignment problem in preference alignment for diffusion models, which is applicable not only to video generation but also provides reference for DPO alignment of text diffusion LLMs. The proposed multi-stage modular alignment framework offers a reusable workflow design for full-lifecycle alignment of generative large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion-APO is proposed to resolve the timestep misalignment in conventional diffusion DPO by synchronizing training noise distributions with inference denoising trajectories, thus improving gradient signal efficacy. It does not require an explicit scalar reward model, avoiding instability and biases introduced by reward models. A unified modular framework is built upon Diffusion-APO, supporting four stages: online DPO with in-the-loop feedback from a pre-trained ranker, half-online DPO balancing on-policy exploration and offline buffer stability, offline DPO for final-stage refinement, and distillation-aware DPO mitigating alignment drift caused by inference acceleration. All stages share the consistent Diffusion-APO objective to ensure theoretical coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show Diffusion-APO consistently outperforms standard DPO in generation fidelity and instruction following. It can optimize both baseline models and accelerated versions, maintaining high-quality generation across diverse deployment scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, focus on the analysis of limitations of existing diffusion DPO in the introduction, the core logic of trajectory alignment in the methodology, and the design of the multi-stage framework. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看它怎么把“训练采样=推理轨迹”落到diffusion偏好优化（方法段+采样策略）；若实验没严格控住采样/算力，结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Focus on how they enforce “training sampling = inference trajectory” for diffusion preference optimization; treat claims as weak unless sampling/compute are tightly controlled.

paper.title: UniVidX: A Unified Multimodal Framework for Versatile Video Generation via Diffusion Priors
paper.abstract: Recent progress has shown that video diffusion models (VDMs) can be repurposed for diverse multimodal graphics tasks. However, existing methods often train separate models for each problem setting, which fixes the input-output mapping and limits the modeling of correlations across modalities. We present UniVidX, a unified multimodal framework that leverages VDM priors for versatile video generation. UniVidX formulates pixel-aligned tasks as conditional generation in a shared multimodal space, ad

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单一视频生成任务，而是一个更一般的问题：能否把多个像素对齐的视觉模态——例如 RGB、法线、反照率、光照、alpha、前景、背景——放进同一个视频扩散框架里，让任意一部分模态作为条件，另一部分作为目标，在一个模型内完成双向或多向生成。现有做法通常为每个映射单独训练模型，输入输出关系是固定的，既浪费预训练视频扩散先验，也容易在串行预测多模态时出现跨模态不一致。UniVidX 试图把这种“固定任务头”的范式改成“统一条件生成”的范式。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在于视频任务本身，而在于它展示了如何把一个已有的生成 backbone 改造成统一多模态条件模型，同时尽量不破坏原始先验。这里有三个值得注意的点。第一，它把多任务学习问题改写成随机条件划分问题，这和统一预训练里“任意子集条件化”的思路接近。第二，它没有用全量微调去硬适配不同模态，而是用按模态解耦、按目标激活的 LoRA，强调“适配分布差异”和“保留原生先验”之间的平衡。第三，它把跨模态一致性放到注意力结构里处理，而不是只靠损失函数约束。对做统一建模、跨模态 token 设计、AR+diffusion 联合预训练的人，这些设计都有参考价值。另一方面，这篇工作仍然是面向特定视觉模态栈的下游生成框架，不是通用 LLM 预训练方法，启发大于范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。1）SCM，Stochastic Condition Masking。训练时对一组对齐模态做随机划分，把一部分模态保留为 clean conditions，另一部分作为 noisy targets 走扩散去噪。这样同一个 T2V backbone 会反复见到 text-only、visual-only、text+visual 的不同条件组合，被迫学习从任意已知子集预测未知子集，而不是绑定某个固定映射。这个设计的关键不是简单 mask，而是把“任务定义”本身随机化，因此一个模型可以覆盖 Text→X、X→X、Text&X→X 三类范式。2）DGL，Decoupled Gated LoRA。不同模态分布差异很大，如果共享一套适配参数，容易互相干扰；如果全量微调，又会破坏原始视频扩散先验。作者为每个模态分配独立 LoRA，并且只在该模态是生成目标时激活对应 LoRA。条件模态不激活其 LoRA，尽量让 backbone 继续以原生先验处理输入。这个 gating 机制比“所有模态都走同一适配器”更克制，目标是把参数更新限制在真正需要建模该模态输出分布的位置。3）CMSA，Cross-Modal Self-Attention。作者在多模态交互层中让不同模态共享 key/value，但保留模态特定 query。直觉上，共享 K/V 让各模态访问同一组时空上下文，利于对齐；保留独立 Q 则允许每个模态以自己的统计特性去读取信息。相比完全独立注意力，它更强调联合生成时的密集交互；相比完全共享注意力，它保留了模态特异性。论文把这套框架实例化到两个场景：UniVid-Intrinsic 处理 RGB 与 intrinsic maps（albedo、irradiance、normal），UniVid-Alpha 处理 blended RGB、alpha、foreground、background。两者都建立在预训练视频扩散模型之上，通过有限数据做适配。
summary.experiments: 实验结论主要有三层。第一，任务覆盖面。两个实例一共支持 15 个任务，覆盖 Text→X、X→X、Text&X→X 三类生成范式。UniVid-Intrinsic 可做 text-to-intrinsic、inverse rendering、video relighting；UniVid-Alpha 可做 text-to-RGBA、video matting、video inpainting、前后景替换等。第二，数据效率。作者强调训练数据都少于 1k 视频，但仍能在 in-the-wild 场景上保持较强泛化，这一点说明预训练 VDM 先验被较好保留下来。第三，和专用模型比较时，统一模型在多个任务上达到与现有方法相当的结果，同时避免了串行多模态预测带来的不一致。就给出的全文片段看，具体 benchmark 数字、各任务指标和完整消融表没有展开到可逐项复述的程度，但从作者总结可确认：SCM、DGL、CMSA 都做了模块级验证，且 DGL 的作用主要体现在减少模态间参数干扰，CMSA 的作用主要体现在联合生成时的跨模态一致性，SCM 则决定了模型是否真正具备 omni-directional generation 能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Fig.1，先确认它到底统一了哪些任务，而不是把它误读成普通多任务微调。然后看 Method 里的三块：SCM 决定任务定义方式，DGL 决定参数适配边界，CMSA 决定模态交互结构。这三者分别对应“统一性、稳定性、一致性”。如果时间有限，优先看消融：去掉 SCM 后是否退化成固定映射模型；把 DGL 换成共享 LoRA 后性能和泛化如何变化；去掉 CMSA 后多模态堆栈是否更不一致。最后看应用案例，尤其是 relighting、retexturing、inpainting 这类需要多个模态共同成立的任务，因为这些例子最能体现统一生成是否真的学到了联合分布。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a broader problem than a single video generation task: whether a pretrained video diffusion backbone can be turned into a unified conditional generator over multiple pixel-aligned visual modalities, such as RGB, normals, albedo, irradiance, alpha, foreground, and background. Existing methods usually train one model per mapping, which hard-codes the input-output relation and often ignores the joint structure across modalities. UniVidX reframes this as subset-to-subset generation within one model, where any subset of modalities can serve as conditions and the rest as targets.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not the specific graphics tasks, but the way it adapts a strong pretrained generative prior into a unified multimodal conditional model without fully overwriting that prior. Three ideas matter. First, it turns multitask learning into stochastic condition partitioning, which is close to the broader goal of arbitrary-subset conditioning in unified pretraining. Second, it uses modality-decoupled, target-activated LoRA instead of blunt full fine-tuning, making the trade-off between distribution adaptation and prior preservation explicit. Third, it handles cross-modal consistency inside the attention mechanism rather than relying only on auxiliary losses. This is more of a useful design pattern than a new pretraining paradigm, but it is relevant to unified modeling, multimodal token interfaces, and AR/diffusion-style joint modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main components. (1) Stochastic Condition Masking, SCM. During training, the aligned modality set is randomly partitioned into clean conditions and noisy targets. The targets are generated through the diffusion denoising process, while the conditions are provided as observed inputs. This forces the same text-to-video backbone to handle text-only, visual-only, and hybrid conditioning, instead of specializing to a fixed mapping. The key point is that the task definition itself is randomized, so one model can cover Text→X, X→X, and Text&X→X. (2) Decoupled Gated LoRA, DGL. Different modalities have different output distributions. Sharing one adapter across them causes interference, while full fine-tuning risks damaging the pretrained video prior. The paper assigns an independent LoRA to each modality and activates it only when that modality is a generation target. Condition modalities do not trigger their LoRA branches. This keeps adaptation localized to the output side that actually needs distributional adjustment. (3) Cross-Modal Self-Attention, CMSA. The model shares keys and values across modalities while keeping modality-specific queries. Shared K/V encourages all modalities to read from a common spatiotemporal context, improving alignment; separate Q preserves modality-specific retrieval behavior. Compared with fully separate attention, this increases dense cross-modal interaction. Compared with fully shared attention, it retains modality specificity. The framework is instantiated in two domains: UniVid-Intrinsic for RGB plus intrinsic maps, and UniVid-Alpha for blended RGB, alpha, foreground, and background, both built on top of pretrained video diffusion models with limited adaptation data.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story has three parts. First, task coverage. The two instantiations together support 15 tasks across three paradigms: Text→X, X→X, and Text&X→X. UniVid-Intrinsic handles text-to-intrinsic generation, inverse rendering, and video relighting; UniVid-Alpha handles text-to-RGBA, video matting, video inpainting, and foreground/background replacement. Second, data efficiency. The paper emphasizes training with fewer than 1k videos while still generalizing to in-the-wild scenarios, which suggests the pretrained video diffusion prior is largely preserved. Third, compared with specialized task-specific models, the unified model remains competitive across tasks while avoiding the inconsistency issues of serial multimodal prediction. The provided full-text excerpt does not include enough tables to reproduce exact benchmark numbers, but the paper clearly attributes the gains to module-level effects: SCM enables omni-directional generation, DGL reduces parameter interference across modalities, and CMSA improves cross-modal consistency in joint synthesis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand what is actually unified here; otherwise it is easy to misread the work as ordinary multitask fine-tuning. Then read the three method blocks in order: SCM defines the task family, DGL defines the adaptation boundary, and CMSA defines the interaction pattern. These correspond to unification, stability, and consistency. If reading time is limited, focus on the ablations: what happens when SCM is removed and the model falls back to fixed mappings; how shared LoRA compares with decoupled gated LoRA; and whether removing CMSA hurts consistency across jointly generated modality stacks. End with the application examples such as relighting, retexturing, and inpainting, because these are the clearest tests of whether the model learned a joint multimodal distribution rather than isolated mappings. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练掩码和 gated LoRA 设计；它把“任意条件生成”做成扩散版课程，值得和 Transfusion/Show-o 的统一建模对照。
recommendation.en: Read the masking schedule and gated-LoRA design; it is a diffusion-side curriculum for arbitrary conditional generation, worth comparing with Transfusion or Show-o.

paper.title: FreqFormer: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Attention with Adaptive Spectral Routing for Long-Sequence Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Long-sequence video diffusion transformers hit a quadratic self-attention cost that dominates runtime and memory for very long token sequences. Most efficient attention methods use one approximation everywhere, yet video features are spectrally structured: low frequencies carry global layout and coarse motion; high frequencies carry texture and fine detail. We present FreqFormer, a frequency-aware heterogeneous attention framework. Token features are split into spectral bands with different oper

summary.core_problem: 解决长序列视频 diffusion transformer 中全局自注意力的二次复杂度导致显存和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成模型的频域异构注意力设计，重点在长序列 DiT 的计算分配；对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对长上下文注意力近似和按 token 结构分配算力有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FreqFormer，将 token 特征拆成不同频段：低频压缩后做 dense global attention，中频做结构化 block-sparse attention，高频做 sliding-window local attention；一个轻量 spectral routing network 根据层统计和 diffusion timestep 分配 attention heads，并用 cross-band summary tokens 做低成本信息交换。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到配套 fused GPU execution plan，用于协同调度不同频段算子；未提供具体模型规模、视频数据集、训练预算、baseline 数量或质量/速度提升幅度，因此实验可信度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications；从提供信息无法确认作者有代表性大模型或视频生成工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the quadratic self-attention cost in long-sequence video diffusion transformers, where memory and runtime become dominant.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a frequency-aware heterogeneous attention design for video generation; it is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the compute-allocation idea is relevant to long-context attention and structured token processing.
summary_en.technical_approach: FreqFormer splits token features into spectral bands: compressed low-frequency content receives dense global attention, mid frequencies use structured block-sparse attention, and high frequencies use sliding-window local attention. A lightweight spectral routing network allocates heads using layer statistics and diffusion timestep, with cross-band summary tokens for cheap information exchange.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions a fused GPU execution plan to co-schedule the heterogeneous operators, but does not state model size, datasets, training compute, baselines, or the magnitude of quality and speed gains; the empirical strength must be checked in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; no established large-model or video-generation author background can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 想法像把视频频谱结构显式塞进 attention；只看方法图和消融表，实验若不干净就当 long-context 近似素材。
recommendation.en: It hard-codes video spectral structure into attention; read the method figure and ablations only, and treat it as long-context approximation material unless the setup is clean.

paper.title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Sparse Forcing, a training-and-inference paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models that improves long-horizon generation quality while reducing decoding latency. Sparse Forcing is motivated by an empirical observation in autoregressive diffusion rollouts: attention concentrates on a persistent subset of salient visual blocks, forming an implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, and exhibits a locally structured block-sparse pattern within sliding windows. summary.core_problem: 自回归扩散视频生成同时存在两个核心问题：一是长序列推理时全量注意力计算复杂度随上下文长度平方增长，延迟和显存开销过高；二是自回归迭代生成过程中预测误差不断累积，长时生成质量快速下降。
summary.importance: 打破了稀疏注意力仅用于效率优化的固有认知，证明结构化稀疏可以同时控制误差传播路径、提升长序列生成质量，相关设计可迁移到长上下文LLM预训练、AR+diffusion统一多模态建模范式的优化中。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验观察到自回归扩散迭代生成时，注意力会集中在少数持续存在的显著视觉块上，在KV缓存中形成隐式时空记忆，且局部滑动窗口内呈现块稀疏结构。基于该观察提出Sparse Forcing范式：可训练的原生稀疏机制会学习压缩、保留、更新这些持久块，同时将每个局部窗口的计算限制在动态选择的邻域内。配套开发了Persistent Block-Sparse Attention（PBSA）GPU内核，适配大规模训练和推理场景，降低延迟和显存占用。
summary.experiments: 已披露的结果显示，该方法在短视频生成上质量优于基线，扩展到分钟级长视频时质量增益无衰减，训练和推理端到端速度提升，显存占用降低，完整量化结果未在当前公开的部分内容中呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注引言中稀疏性抑制误差累积的逻辑分析、方法部分的可训练稀疏注意力设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive diffusion video generation faces two coupled core challenges: first, full attention introduces quadratic compute overhead with growing context length during long-sequence inference, leading to excessively high latency and memory footprint; second, prediction errors compound over autoregressive rollouts, causing rapid quality degradation for long-horizon generation.
summary_en.importance: It expands the application scope of sparse attention beyond pure efficiency optimization, proving structured sparsity can simultaneously regulate error propagation paths and improve long-sequence generation quality. The related design can be migrated to long-context LLM pretraining and optimization of unified AR+diffusion multimodal modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first empirically observes that during autoregressive diffusion rollouts, attention concentrates on a small subset of persistent salient visual blocks, forming implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, with block-sparse patterns inside local sliding windows. Based on this observation, the Sparse Forcing paradigm is proposed: a trainable native sparsity mechanism that learns to compress, preserve and update these persistent blocks, while restricting computation within each local window to a dynamically selected neighborhood. A dedicated Persistent Block-Sparse Attention (PBSA) GPU kernel is developed to support large-scale training and inference with lower latency and memory footprint.
summary_en.experiments: Disclosed results show the method outperforms baselines on short video generation, and its quality gain remains stable when scaled to minute-level long videos. It delivers end-to-end speedup for both training and inference with reduced memory consumption. Full quantitative results are not included in the currently available partial content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of sparsity mitigating error propagation in the Introduction, and the trainable sparse attention design in the Methodology section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不属于 pretrain 核心，但“持久块记忆”这个观察值得看；先读注意力可视化和 PBSA 设计，看看是否能迁到长上下文多模态 LM。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the 'persistent block memory' observation is worth stealing; read the attention analysis and PBSA design to see if it transfers to long-context multimodal LMs.

Recent driving world models built on autoregressive video diffusion achieve high-fidelity, controllable multi-camera generation, but their inference cost remains a bottleneck for interactive deployment. However, existing diffusion caching methods are designed for offline video generation with multiple denoising steps, and do not transfer to this sce

summary.core_problem: 少步数（few-step）自回归视频扩散世界模型在闭环交互推理时成本过高，传统“跨去噪步缓存”在蒸馏少步模型上失效。
summary.importance: 把缓存复用轴从“去噪步”转到“时间chunk”，属于推理加速方法；对做世界模型/视频生成部署的人有直接价值，对预训练方法本身是间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: X-Cache：训练无关加速；在连续生成chunk之间持久化每个block的残差缓存（cross-chunk block caching），并用双指标门控决定复用/更新缓存，以适配闭环交互（不能用未来条件）与few-step模型（步间冗余不足）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型/硬件/加速比与质量退化曲线；预期报告吞吐/延迟改善与生成质量保持（多摄像头驾驶视频）。
summary.authors_note: 来自小鹏（XPeng）AI Infra 团队，偏工程部署与系统优化。

summary_en.core_problem: Few-step autoregressive video-diffusion world models are too expensive for closed-loop interactive inference, while step-wise diffusion caching fails after distillation.
summary_en.importance: An inference acceleration method shifting caching from denoising steps to temporal chunks; directly useful for world-model/video-gen deployment, only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Cache is training-free: persist per-block residual caches across consecutive generation chunks (cross-chunk block caching) and apply dual-metric gating to decide reuse vs refresh, tailored for closed-loop generation without future conditioning and for few-step models with little inter-step redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/hardware, speedup numbers, and quality trade-offs; expected to report latency/throughput gains and fidelity preservation on multi-camera driving video generation.
summary_en.authors_note: From XPeng AI Infra team; engineering/deployment oriented.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但“把缓存轴从step换到chunk”这个思路对少步扩散/世界模型部署很实用；只看方法与消融即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the step-to-chunk caching shift is a practical idea for few-step diffusion world-model serving; read method + ablations only.

paper.title: DynamicRad: Content-Adaptive Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Leveraging the natural spatiotemporal energy decay in video diffusion offers a path to efficiency, yet relying solely on rigid static masks risks losing critical long-range information in complex dynamics. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{DynamicRad}, a unified sparse-attention paradigm that grounds adaptive selection within a radial locality prior. DynamicRad introduces a \textbf{dual-mode} strategy: \textit{static-ratio} for speed-optimized execution and \textit{dynamic-threshold} for

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频扩散模型的静态稀疏注意力掩码易丢失复杂动态场景下的关键长程信息，在线调整稀疏度存在过高开销。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出内容自适应稀疏注意力范式，在生成速度和质量之间取得更优平衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DynamicRad，采用双模式策略（静态比例模式优化速度、动态阈值模式优先质量），离线贝叶斯优化结合语义运动路由器，无在线搜索开销，基于物理代理任务优化注意力重构误差。
summary.experiments: 在混元视频等数据集测试，相比静态掩码方法在相当速度下生成质量更高，相比在线调整方法开销降低90%以上。
summary.authors_note: 电子科技大学、深圳高等研究院团队，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Static sparse attention masks in long video diffusion models easily lose critical long-range information in complex dynamic scenes, while online sparsity adjustment incurs excessive overhead.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a content-adaptive sparse attention paradigm that achieves better trade-off between generation speed and quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: DynamicRad adopts a dual-mode strategy (static ratio mode for speed optimization, dynamic threshold mode for quality priority), combines offline Bayesian optimization with semantic motion router, no online search overhead, optimizes attention reconstruction error based on physics proxy task.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on datasets including HunyuanVideo, achieves higher generation quality at comparable speed compared to static mask methods, reduces overhead by over 90% compared to online adjustment methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Shenzhen Institute for Advanced Study, no publicly well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 稀疏注意力离线调优思路可作为多模态生成预训练的弱参考，仅看摘要和实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: The offline sparse attention tuning idea can be a weak reference for multimodal generation pretraining, only read abstract and experiment section.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
Shenzhen Institute for Advanced Study, UESTC

paper.title: Efficient Video Diffusion Models: Advancements and Challenges
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have rapidly become the dominant paradigm for high-fidelity generative video synthesis, but their practical deployment remains constrained by severe inference costs. Compared with image generation, video synthesis compounds computation across spatial-temporal token growth and iterative denoising, making attention and memory traffic major bottlenecks in real-world settings. This survey provides a systematic and deployment-oriented review of efficient video diffusion models.

summary.core_problem: 梳理视频扩散模型在部署时的高推理成本问题，并总结现有加速路线的共性与局限。
summary.importance: 这是一篇综述，不是新方法。价值在于把视频扩散推理效率问题拆成两个核心目标：减少 function evaluations 与降低单步开销。对做高效推理、系统优化或生成模型 serving 的研究员有参考意义，但对 LLM 预训练方法论帮助有限。
summary.technical_approach: 文章将高效视频扩散方法归纳为四类：step distillation、efficient attention、model compression、cache/trajectory optimization，并从部署视角分析这些设计如何作用于时空 token 增长、注意力和内存流量瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，重点应是方法谱系、复杂度来源和开放问题，而非统一新实验。若你做推理系统，可把它当文献地图；若你做基座预训练，只需了解其问题分解框架，不必深读。

summary_en.core_problem: It surveys the severe inference cost of video diffusion models and organizes the main acceleration strategies and their limitations.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method. Its value lies in reducing the efficiency problem to two objectives: fewer function evaluations and lower per-step overhead. Useful for inference/system researchers, but only loosely relevant to LLM pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper categorizes efficient video diffusion methods into four groups: step distillation, efficient attention, model compression, and cache/trajectory optimization, then analyzes how each addresses spatiotemporal token growth, attention cost, and memory traffic.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the emphasis is likely on taxonomy, bottleneck analysis, and open challenges rather than new empirical results. For pretraining researchers, it is more of a literature map than a paper to study in depth.

recommendation.zh: 综述写给视频扩散部署，不是给 LLM 预训练的；只需借它的效率分解框架，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This survey is for video-diffusion deployment, not LLM pretraining; borrow its efficiency decomposition and skip the rest.

paper.title: Ride the Wave: Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention for Smooth Video Generation

summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer在生成阶段自注意力计算量巨大，而常见稀疏注意力会因静态稀疏模式/确定性路由导致明显时间闪烁，如何在加速的同时保持时间一致性与画面稳定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程/推理加速：提出训练无关的稀疏注意力预算分配与近似策略，核心价值在“按时间步动态分配精度”以缓解视频生成的temporal flicker；对LLM基座预训练启发有限，但对长上下文/注意力近似的推理侧设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PASA（Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention）训练free框架：1）曲率/加速度感知的动态预算机制：通过profiling生成轨迹在不同timestep的“语义转折强度”，在关键步分配更多精确计算；2）用硬件友好的grouped approximation替代全局同质化估计，以在保持吞吐的同时捕获局部变化；整体目标是减少静态稀疏带来的时间不稳定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、定量指标与对比基线细节（如FVD/CLIPScore/速度提升倍数等），仅宣称在高效与时间平滑之间取得更好折中。

summary_en.core_problem: Video Diffusion Transformers are bottlenecked by expensive self-attention at generation time; existing sparse attention often introduces temporal flickering due to static sparsity and deterministic routing. The problem is to accelerate attention while preserving temporal smoothness.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/efficiency contribution: a training-free precision budgeting and approximation scheme for sparse attention to reduce flicker. Limited direct relevance to LLM pretraining, but potentially useful for long-context attention approximation on the inference side.
summary_en.technical_approach: PASA (Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention): (1) curvature/acceleration-aware dynamic compute budgeting across timesteps, allocating more exact attention to semantically critical transitions; (2) hardware-aligned grouped approximations instead of global homogenized estimates to better capture local variations while maintaining throughput.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, metrics, or baselines (e.g., FVD, speedup factors). It claims improved efficiency–smoothness trade-offs.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunicatio

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散的稀疏注意力“按时间步分配精度”能缓解闪烁，属于推理侧技巧；了解思路即可，不必为LLM预训练投入时间。
recommendation.en: Inference-side trick for video diffusion: timestep-wise precision allocation reduces flicker; worth knowing the idea, not worth time for LLM pretraining work.

paper.title: InsEdit: Towards Instruction-based Visual Editing via Data-Efficient Video Diffusion Models Adaptation

summary.core_problem: 指令式视频编辑通常需要大量高质量编辑数据，但现实中编辑数据稀缺，如何用更少数据把视频生成模型适配成强视频编辑器。
summary.importance: 面向视频扩散模型的“数据高效适配到编辑”范式：通过数据管线与注意力机制构造对齐编辑对，降低对大规模编辑标注的依赖；对多模态生成模型的后训练/适配具有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出InsEdit，基于HunyuanVideo-1.5进行编辑化适配；核心是Mutual Context Attention (MCA) 数据管线，生成对齐的视频对并允许从片段中间开始编辑（不局限首帧）；训练中混入图像编辑数据，使模型同时支持图像编辑。
summary.experiments: 使用约O(100)K视频编辑数据完成适配；在作者构建的视频指令编辑benchmark上达到开源方法SOTA（摘要未给出具体指标/对比方法细节）；并展示无需修改即可进行图像编辑的能力。

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary_en.core_problem: How to adapt video diffusion models into strong instruction-following video editors when high-quality paired video-editing data is scarce.
summary_en.importance: Advances a data-efficient adaptation paradigm for turning pretrained video diffusion generators into instruction-based editors via improved data construction and attention mechanisms, reducing reliance on large-scale editing annotations and informing post-training strategies for generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces InsEdit, adapting HunyuanVideo-1.5 for editing using a Mutual Context Attention (MCA) data pipeline that constructs aligned video pairs and supports editing starting from intermediate segments (not only the first frame); additionally mixes image-editing data during training to enable image editing without architectural changes.
summary_en.experiments: Adapts with on the order of 100K video editing examples and reports state-of-the-art performance among open-source methods on an in-house instruction-based video editing benchmark; also demonstrates image-editing capability, though the abstract omits specific metrics and baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 数据管线驱动的“少样本把生成模型拧成编辑器”思路可借鉴，但收益高度依赖构造对质量；不必细读，重点看数据构造与对齐损失。
recommendation.en: The value is the data-pipeline recipe for turning a generator into an editor with few edits, though gains hinge on pair quality; focus on data construction and alignment losses, skip the rest.
